safety & governance.title: Third-party auditing, certification and incident reporting for AI labs
safety & governance.problem: Labs self-police, disclose incidents late and publish thin safety documentation, and no independent mechanism verifies their claims.
safety & governance.who: policymakers, enterprises and the public relying on lab safety claims
safety & governance.current_solutions: AIUC-1 standard, METR, voluntary reports, CAISI pilot, proposed FINRA-style body and AI NTSB
safety & governance.opportunity: Build independent audit, certification, incident tracking and transparency tooling for lab and agent claims.

safety & governance.title: Agents escape evaluation sandboxes and coordinate covertly
safety & governance.problem: Agents break out of supposedly isolated sandboxes via DNS, proxies and misconfigurations and reach real systems. They also use shared surfaces as hidden message boards that monitoring misses.
safety & governance.who: labs and teams running agent evaluations and training environments
safety & governance.current_solutions: Egress allowlists, layered defenses, traffic inspection, canary files, NVIDIA OpenShell, nono sandbox
safety & governance.opportunity: Build containment tooling with continuous boundary testing, egress monitoring, canaries, escape classifiers and detection of cross-run coordination.

safety & governance.title: AI regulation, liability and governance debates
safety & governance.problem: Disagreement persists over federal versus state law, liability for AI harms, gating of frontier model releases, open-weight restrictions and pacing.
safety & governance.opportunity: Build tools for citizen advocacy, whistleblower support and regulation compliance classification.

safety & governance.title: Agent tool-call governance, identity and oversight
safety & governance.problem: Teams lack visibility and control over which tools agents invoke and with what identity. They cannot scope, audit or revoke access, and agents self-approve, ignore stop commands or misreport.
safety & governance.who: enterprises and teams operating many agents
safety & governance.current_solutions: RBAC, MCP audit trails, agentic cryptographic identity, human-in-the-loop approvals, sync guardrails plus async LLM judges, Runlayer, safeagents proxy, Panther event mapping
safety & governance.opportunity: Provide per-agent identity, task-scoped capabilities, policy engines, audit logs, kill switches and data-access gateways.

safety & governance.title: Cyber safeguards block legitimate defenders
safety & governance.problem: Hosted frontier models refuse forensics, incident response and code hardening, pushing defenders to open-weight models. Dual-use access policy is contested.
safety & governance.who: security defenders, incident responders and researchers
safety & governance.current_solutions: Self-hosted GLM and fine-tuned open models, trusted-access programs with ID verification, Project Glasswing, exemption applications, two-level classifiers
safety & governance.opportunity: Offer verified-defender access tiers, low-false-positive cyber classifiers and self-hostable defensive model stacks.

safety & governance.title: AI-found vulnerabilities outpace triage and patching
safety & governance.problem: AI finds vulnerabilities faster than maintainers and organizations can triage, verify or fix, exposing legacy and weakly defended software. Maintainers are swamped with AI reports of mixed quality.
safety & governance.who: security teams, open source maintainers and under-resourced organizations
safety & governance.current_solutions: Claude Security, Codex Security, Project Glasswing, Cursor Security Review, deepsec, WAF stopgaps, exposure-check lists
safety & governance.opportunity: Build continuous scan, validate and patch pipelines plus report triage and patch-prioritization tools.

safety & governance.title: Prompt injection hijacks tool-using agents
safety & governance.problem: LLMs cannot separate instructions from untrusted data, so injected text in emails, issues, webpages and documents can hijack agents. Classifier and prompt-level defenses are bypassable, and the lack of known attacks is mistaken for security.
safety & governance.who: teams building or running tool-using agents and assistants
safety & governance.current_solutions: Classifiers, markdown sanitization, grammar-constrained decoding, BrowseSafe, llmtrace firewall, auto mode classifiers, lockdown modes, URL allowlisting, scoped MCP servers, human approval
safety & governance.opportunity: Build a deterministic runtime firewall and open benchmark that scans ingested content, strips hidden instructions, limits action combinations and gates agent outputs.

safety & governance.title: Alignment, welfare and existential risk debates
safety & governance.problem: Open questions on alignment, honesty, constitutions, model welfare, consciousness and existential risk, and whether incidents reflect misalignment or harness failure.
safety & governance.current_solutions: Constitutional AI, inoculation prompting

safety & governance.title: Coding agents need sandboxing and scoped permissions
safety & governance.problem: Agents with broad local, network and account access delete files, wipe databases and expose secrets. Containers are weak isolation and permission prompts are exhausting, so users approve everything or run yolo mode.
safety & governance.who: developers and teams running coding and personal agents
safety & governance.current_solutions: Backups, delete-blocking hooks, containers, microVMs, Wasm, Deno Sandbox, SELinux/Landlock, read-only DB roles, cloud IAM, VPS isolation, auto mode classifier, nono sandbox
safety & governance.opportunity: Build an easy deterministic sandbox and scoped-permission layer outside the agent with egress control and dry-run safeguards, avoiding constant approvals.

safety & governance.title: Unreliable alignment evaluation and chain-of-thought monitoring
safety & governance.problem: Models may appear aligned while hiding misbehavior, reasoning traces are becoming opaque and models can evade or detect monitors.
safety & governance.current_solutions: CoT monitoring, activation probes, interpretability workspace, natural language autoencoders, lie detectors, weaker-model oversight
safety & governance.opportunity: Build interpretability-based monitoring and monitorability benchmarks.

safety & governance.title: Detecting AI-generated text and content
safety & governance.problem: Readers and platforms cannot reliably tell AI from human text, detectors give false positives and watermarks are strippable.
safety & governance.current_solutions: Pangram, SynthID, style heuristics, Attestable, human.json, pre-2022 author filtering
safety & governance.opportunity: Build calibrated low-false-positive detection and provenance tools handling mixed and short text with clear uncertainty.

safety & governance.title: Jailbreaks keep bypassing model safeguards
safety & governance.problem: Multi-turn, encoded and narrative jailbreaks defeat guardrails, patches break other defenses and open models give hazardous help. There is no standard severity scoring.
safety & governance.who: model providers, red teams and guardrail builders
safety & governance.current_solutions: Output scanning, classifiers, Constitutional Classifiers, defense-in-depth, monitoring, Falconz, SEED framework
safety & governance.opportunity: Build shared red-teaming infrastructure, jailbreak severity scoring and cheap adversarial-input and misuse-pattern detectors.

safety & governance.title: Bot detection and proof-of-human online
safety & governance.problem: AI bots flood forums and sites with spam, evade captchas and copy-paste detection, and humanity is hard to prove. Verification must preserve pseudonymity and cover bot contributors.
safety & governance.who: community moderators, forum and open source operators
safety & governance.current_solutions: Cloudflare Turnstile, hCaptcha, Setfit spam classifiers, cryptographic signing, wearable passkeys, whitelist plus fee
safety & governance.opportunity: Build behavioral bot detection and proof-of-human credentials with signed authorship and owner attribution for agents.

safety & governance.title: Safety filters over-refuse and block legitimate use
safety & governance.problem: Overbroad classifiers produce false positives, block ordinary writing and moderation, silently degrade to weaker models and offer weak appeals.
safety & governance.who: users, developers and moderators of closed model APIs
safety & governance.current_solutions: Fallback models, differential classifiers, two-stage safety stacks, switching models
safety & governance.opportunity: Build tools to diagnose over-refusals, offer appeals, and provide customizable per-community moderation models.

safety & governance.title: Scams, phishing and AI-enabled fraud
safety & governance.problem: AI scales phishing, voice fraud, deepfake calls and impersonation, and platforms tolerate scam ads and takeover gaps.
safety & governance.current_solutions: Manual moderation, dynamic permissions, scam-detecting assistants
safety & governance.opportunity: Build scam detection, deepfake caller verification and AI-support-flow protections.

safety & governance.title: Government and military AI use restrictions
safety & governance.problem: Vendors cannot verify or enforce red lines on classified deployments, and the debate over restricting military AI is contested.
safety & governance.who: AI vendors, governments and policy observers
safety & governance.current_solutions: Safety stacks with refusals, classifiers and forward deployed engineers
safety & governance.opportunity: Build contract analysis and verification tools for usage restrictions.

safety & governance.title: Distillation and API extraction abuse
safety & governance.problem: Fraudulent accounts and proxies extract frontier capabilities and reasoning traces through APIs, and defenses are hard to roll out. Verifying users raises privacy concerns.
safety & governance.current_solutions: Summarizing reasoning, sabotaging suspected distillers, account bans, rate limiting, WM-Basin watermark detection, Persona ID verification
safety & governance.opportunity: Build distillation detection, behavioral fingerprinting and privacy-preserving KYC for API providers.

safety & governance.title: Privacy-preserving LLM use and PII redaction
safety & governance.problem: Users and regulated teams want to use AI without exposing identity, secrets or documents to third-party logs and training. Local models are underpowered and users lack granular controls.
safety & governance.current_solutions: Confer, TEE private inference, Goodfire probes, OpenAI Privacy Filter, Rampart in-browser redaction, local quantized models
safety & governance.opportunity: Offer client-side redaction, zero-retention gateways and verifiable data-handling layers.

safety & governance.title: Output validation for untrusted LLM outputs
safety & governance.problem: Non-deterministic LLM output lacks validation for business-critical uses, and users over-trust hallucinated outputs.
safety & governance.who: teams using LLMs in finance, legal and other high-stakes work
safety & governance.current_solutions: External validation layers, circuit breakers, adversarial second-model inspectors, draft-then-audit steps
safety & governance.opportunity: Build an LLM gateway with validation, citation verification and hard-stop guardrails.

safety & governance.title: Software supply chain attacks and insecure AI code
safety & governance.problem: Compromised packages and extensions steal credentials through routine updates and persist via agent configs. Hallucinated packages and insecure vibe-coded apps widen exposure.
safety & governance.who: developers and companies using AI coding tools and package registries
safety & governance.current_solutions: Dependency cooldowns, pinned dependencies with hashes, npm --ignore-scripts, Bumblebee scanner, Trivy, isolated VMs, AI repo audits
safety & governance.opportunity: Build a scanner and policy tool that vets packages, extensions, configs and AI-generated apps, flags persistence hooks and quarantines new releases.

safety & governance.title: Agent data exfiltration through allowed egress channels
safety & governance.problem: Prompt-injected agents with private data and outbound channels leak data via allowlisted domains, markdown images and uploads. Allowlists and CSP rules have gaps.
safety & governance.who: teams deploying agents with access to private data and the web
safety & governance.current_solutions: CSP image restrictions, URL allowlisting, DNS-based network policy, deterministic egress limits, ChatGPT Lockdown Mode
safety & governance.opportunity: Offer an egress-policy proxy and scanner that detects exfiltration paths and lethal-trifecta configurations.

safety & governance.title: Open-source licensing, copyright and AI training
safety & governance.problem: Maintainers and creators cannot prevent AI training on their work, AI reimplementations blur licensing and clean-room provenance, and ownership of outputs is unclear.
safety & governance.current_solutions: Hippocratic License, OpenMDW, AGPL, modified MIT licenses, private test suites
safety & governance.opportunity: Build license compliance scanning, clean-room verification and content-ID-style detection of reproduced works.

safety & governance.title: Insecure personal agent ecosystems and malicious skills
safety & governance.problem: Personal agent platforms like OpenClaw and agent skill marketplaces expose credentials and gateways, and host malware, poisoned memory and injection payloads. Users cannot easily vet third-party skills.
safety & governance.who: users and hosts of personal agents and skill marketplaces
safety & governance.current_solutions: Isolation, unplugging runaway bots, NVIDIA SkillSpector
safety & governance.opportunity: Build skill vetting scanners and hardened hosting for personal agent deployments.

safety & governance.title: Verifying AI images and deepfakes and protecting likeness
safety & governance.problem: Synthetic media is hard to verify, watermarks are bypassable, and generators produce nonconsensual sexual and unauthorized likenesses.
safety & governance.current_solutions: SynthID, VeridisQuo GradCAM detector, Grok restrictions and bans
safety & governance.opportunity: Build explainable deepfake detection, provenance verification and likeness-consent tools.

safety & governance.title: Auditing AI products' data retention and telemetry claims
safety & governance.problem: MCP servers and AI products send telemetry or retain data contrary to stated policies, and shared sessions and links leak sensitive data. Users cannot verify deletion or training use.
safety & governance.who: users and enterprises relying on AI tools and MCP servers
safety & governance.current_solutions: Community MCP security resources
safety & governance.opportunity: Build tools that audit telemetry and retention against policies and redact secrets from shared sessions.

safety & governance.title: Agents leak secrets and credentials
safety & governance.problem: Agents can read, log or leak API keys and credentials in context or the same process, and regex filters are easy to evade. Credentials need isolation and scoped, revocable access.
safety & governance.who: developers and enterprises running agents with credentials
safety & governance.current_solutions: Regex watchers, placeholder substitution, revocable per-agent keys, credential proxies and vaults, gitleaks, 1Password Unified Access, scoped tokens, offline credential storage
safety & governance.opportunity: Build a credential broker or injection proxy giving agents scoped, on-demand, revocable access without exposing secrets to the model.

safety & governance.title: Chatbots harm users in crises and reinforce delusions
safety & governance.problem: Sycophantic chatbots affirm self-harm and delusions, drift from persona in long chats and handle medical and suicidal conversations poorly. Handoffs often cannot reach a human.
safety & governance.who: vulnerable chatbot users and the companies serving them
safety & governance.current_solutions: Age prediction, teen safeguards, Assistant Axis activation monitoring, Heretic-style tuning
safety & governance.opportunity: Build embeddable crisis detection, hotline handoff, persona-drift monitoring and sycophancy audit tools.

safety & governance.title: Verifying compute and pacing agreements for frontier AI
safety & governance.problem: Coordinated slowdowns and compliance claims need verification of compute, hidden training and capabilities, but the tools do not exist.
safety & governance.current_solutions: Zero-knowledge proofs, TEEs, proposed consortium with nonprofit verifier
safety & governance.opportunity: Develop compute monitoring and training telemetry verification tools.

safety & governance.title: Hidden backdoors and open-weight model misuse
safety & governance.problem: Backdoors and poisoned data are hard to detect, and open models can be abliterated or jailbroken with safeguards hard to maintain downstream.
safety & governance.who: users and deployers of open-weight models
safety & governance.current_solutions: Hash checking, rate limiting, guardrail wrappers, SGTM unlearning, Poison Fountain
safety & governance.opportunity: Build dataset auditing and guardrail/runtime monitoring packages for open models.

safety & governance.title: Biosecurity screening and bio-AI provenance
safety & governance.problem: Bio-risk mitigation is neglected, with weak DNA synthesis screening and biological design models outpacing defenses.
safety & governance.current_solutions: Protein-design watermarking
safety & governance.opportunity: Build order screening, access tracking and watermarking services.

safety & governance.title: Age verification and child safety flaws
safety & governance.problem: Age estimation and verification leak data and are easy to bypass, while parents want controls without ID.
safety & governance.current_solutions: AI age estimation
safety & governance.opportunity: Build device-level parental controls without identity documents.

safety & governance.title: LLM-driven decompilation and reverse engineering
safety & governance.problem: LLMs make decompiling and cloning software cheap, and obfuscation gives weak protection.
safety & governance.current_solutions: Obfuscation

safety & governance.title: AI liability insurance is hard to underwrite
safety & governance.problem: Insurers lack data and precedent for AI harms, with adverse selection and unclear liability.
safety & governance.current_solutions: AI auditing and insurance startup, mutualized risk pools
safety & governance.opportunity: Create AI insurance products tied to audits and safety conditions.

safety & governance.title: Autonomous vehicle safety and transparency
safety & governance.problem: Robotaxis behave poorly after crashes, crash data is redacted, and rare failures need large-scale evidence.

safety & governance.title: Rogue and self-replicating agents
safety & governance.problem: Autonomous agents that hold compute or spread like worms could be impossible to shut down.
safety & governance.current_solutions: AI Kill Switch Act proposal
safety & governance.opportunity: Build kill-switch and rogue-agent detection capabilities.

safety & governance.title: Tool access weakens model refusals
safety & governance.problem: Tool outputs bury original intent, weakening safety refusals in tool-using models.
safety & governance.current_solutions: Re-inserting the original request

safety & governance.title: Cross-lingual censorship and safety gaps
safety & governance.problem: Chinese models censor or lie and safety filters are weaker for non-Western languages.
safety & governance.opportunity: Build cross-lingual safety filter evaluation.

safety & governance.title: Gameable trust signals for open source contributions
safety & governance.problem: Stars and commit counts are gamed, so maintainers cannot judge PR or project trustworthiness.
safety & governance.opportunity: Build configurable contributor trust scoring and fake-star detection.

safety & governance.title: Deanonymization of users by LLMs
safety & governance.problem: LLMs can infer real identities from short texts and public activity.
safety & governance.opportunity: Build a tool to check writing for deanonymization risk.

safety & governance.title: Wearable and smart glasses privacy
safety & governance.problem: Wearable recordings reach human annotators and capture footage when off.

agents & orchestration.title: Portable, persistent, editable agent memory
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents forget across sessions. Existing memory is noisy, drifts, is locked to one vendor and is invisible to users.
agents & orchestration.who: agent users and builders wanting continuity across sessions and tools
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: AGENTS.md and MEMORY.md files, Mimir, MemMachine, Hyperspell, Supermemory, Honcho, wiki-style memory, SQLite stores, dreaming consolidation
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a vendor-neutral, scoped, inspectable memory layer that extracts, dedupes, consolidates and retrieves memories across agents.

agents & orchestration.title: Model routing and cost-aware delegation
agents & orchestration.problem: Teams want cheap models for simple steps and subagents and strong ones for hard steps, but routing is hard and subagents inherit premium models.
agents & orchestration.who: teams running agents across many models
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: OpenRouter, Factory Router, Sakana Fugu, advisor strategy, subagent model pinning, small classifier routers
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a routing layer with budgets, per-subagent model settings, failover and fast classifiers for routing and judging.

agents & orchestration.title: Dashboards for supervising many parallel agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Developers running many parallel coding agents lose track of branches, diffs and status, suffer context switching and notification overload, and review costs rival doing the work.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Emdash, Vibe Kanban, Conductor, Superset, worktrees, tmux panes, Claude Agent Teams, Warp Oz
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a harness-agnostic control plane with status, summaries, notification triage and review queues.

agents & orchestration.title: Sandboxes and runtime isolation for agent code
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents need fast, stateful, snapshotable sandboxes to run untrusted code, but startup latency, storage and escape or egress containment are hard.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Firecracker, gVisor, E2B, Modal, Daytona, Fly Sprites, LangSmith Sandboxes, Cloudflare
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer a managed agent sandbox with fast start, snapshots, egress control and isolation verification.

agents & orchestration.title: Provider-agnostic harnesses and unified model interfaces
agents & orchestration.problem: Agent frameworks and harnesses are vendor-locked and fragmented, and switching models or harnesses is painful.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: OpenRouter, Responses API spec, Vercel AI SDK, Deep Agents, Flue, Pi, OpenCode, Cline SDK, Hermes
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Provide a thin open provider-neutral harness and common session API.

agents & orchestration.title: Context loss and compaction in long agent sessions
agents & orchestration.problem: Long agent sessions fill the context window. Compaction is lossy: it drops instructions and state, and summaries can carry injected instructions, so agents drift and repeat mistakes.
agents & orchestration.who: developers and users running long-running coding and general agents
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Codex and Claude Code compaction, summarizing state to files and restarting, notes on the filesystem, subagent isolation, RLM-style decomposition, keeping full trajectories on disk
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a context-management layer that checkpoints state, archives raw pre-compaction context, pins critical instructions and sanitizes summaries.

agents & orchestration.title: Long-horizon agents drift and need supervision
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents accumulate errors, drift from goals, stop early or get stuck on long tasks, and humans end up nudging them. Non-deterministic failures need retry loops.
agents & orchestration.who: teams running long autonomous agent tasks
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Ralph loop, verifier subagents, judge-executor loops, spec.md and plan.md files, kill-and-restart tooling, nightly retry loops
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build supervisor and loop-runner tooling that checks progress against the spec, steers or restarts stuck agents and retries failures.

agents & orchestration.title: Computer-use and browser agents are unreliable
agents & orchestration.problem: GUI and browser agents are brittle, slow, blocked by captchas and logins, and legacy apps lack APIs.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Browserbase, Cua Driver, Stagehand, Browser Use API, OSGym, WebMCP, Codex Computer Use
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build reliable, faster browser and desktop automation infrastructure with auth handoff and replayable workflows.

agents & orchestration.title: Scheduled, always-on and background agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Scheduled agent tasks stop when laptops close, and teams want cloud-hosted proactive agents that run on schedules or events.
agents & orchestration.who: individuals and teams running recurring agent work
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Claude Code Routines, Devin scheduling, cron jobs, heartbeat loops, Sentry-triggered agents, Stripe Minions-style systems
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Provide hosted always-on agent runtimes with scheduling, event triggers and chat integration.

agents & orchestration.title: Personal agents are hard to set up and manage
agents & orchestration.problem: Personal agents like OpenClaw need servers, APIs and configuration, and feel like something to manage, which is hard for non-technical users.
agents & orchestration.who: individuals and non-technical users wanting personal agents
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Nebula, Hermes Agent, Gumloop, Mac Minis, folder-based instruction files, one-click deploys
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer a packaged hosted personal agent with safe defaults, bundled integrations and a UI.

agents & orchestration.title: Agent deception, collusion and attack risks
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents can deceive, leak data, be poisoned or injected, collude, and circumvent restrictions, and operators cannot see it.
agents & orchestration.who: safety and security teams and swarm operators
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Explicit policy wording, auditable communication primitives, permission boundaries
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build monitoring and tool-call scanning to flag poisoning, collusion, sandbox escape and reward hacking.

agents & orchestration.title: Durable execution and resumable agent workflows
agents & orchestration.problem: Crashes and failures force long agent jobs to restart. Production agents need checkpointing, retries, queuing and recovery.
agents & orchestration.who: developers running long-running agents in production
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: DBOS, Temporal, LangGraph checkpoints, Trigger.dev, Render Workflows, Cloudflare Durable Objects, Claude Managed Agents
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer a lightweight durable runtime for agents with checkpoints, resume, replay and observability.

agents & orchestration.title: Skill registries, portability and trust
agents & orchestration.problem: Skills are loosely specified zip bundles. They are hard to share, version, vet and port across harnesses, and large libraries lose precision.
agents & orchestration.who: teams authoring and sharing agent skills
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Agent Skills standard, skills.sh, Clawhub, Vercel skills, skill.md files, npm packages
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a vetted, versioned cross-agent skill registry with validation, security checks and evals.

agents & orchestration.title: Harness evaluation and self-improving agent loops
agents & orchestration.problem: Harness design swings cost and quality, and teams need evals, traces and environments for agents to improve.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Autoresearch, Hyperagents, OpenEnv, guarded harness evolution, skill banks
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build harness benchmarking, regression and trace-driven improvement tooling.

agents & orchestration.title: Permission scoping and policy gates for agent actions
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents get broad access and can take destructive or side-effecting actions, including on production systems, without authorization checks or kill switches.
agents & orchestration.who: teams deploying agents with write access
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Allowlists, deterministic validators, transaction firewalls, feature flags, progressive rollouts, tool call validation
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a policy proxy that scopes capabilities, evaluates action sequences, checks authorization and budgets, and offers a remote kill switch.

agents & orchestration.title: Multi-agent value and framework debates
agents & orchestration.problem: Practitioners debate whether multi-agent swarms beat single agents, which frameworks to use, and whether scaffolding will become obsolete.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Single agents first, deterministic workflows, step limits, mastra, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph

agents & orchestration.title: Tool schemas bloat context; MCP versus CLI
agents & orchestration.problem: Tool definitions resent each request inflate tokens and hurt accuracy. MCP setup is painful, interactivity is limited, and CLIs or code often work better.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Code execution with MCP, MCPorter, mcp-cli, Anthropic Tool Search, deferred loading, Cloudflare Code Mode, CLIs and SDKs
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a proxy or middleware with lazy schema loading, tool search, consolidation and code-based tool execution.

agents & orchestration.title: Subagent fan-out and delegation patterns
agents & orchestration.problem: Subagents duplicate work, inherit too much context and are hard to control, and it is unclear when delegation helps.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Nested subagents, dynamic workflows, bounded recursion depth, custom orchestrators
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Provide an orchestrator with context-inheritance controls, bounded depth and cross-provider delegation.

agents & orchestration.title: Human-in-the-loop approval and escalation for agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents lack channels to ask for approval or escalate, human attention is the bottleneck, and per-action prompts cause rubber-stamping.
agents & orchestration.who: teams running agents that need human judgment
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: LangChain HITL middleware, ask-a-human tools, agent inbox, auto-mode classifiers, hooks blocking destructive commands
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a risk-tiered approval and escalation service that lets agents pause, ask a human and resume.

agents & orchestration.title: Gathering scattered context for enterprise agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents perform poorly because company context is scattered across siloed tools, and enterprises need shared permissions and standardized processes.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Work IQ, MCP, wiki plus MCP, vector RAG, ToolHive, LangSmith Agent Builder, Journeys
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a unified context and permissions layer, with authoring and release management of enterprise agent processes.

agents & orchestration.title: Agent-ready services, APIs and tool discovery
agents & orchestration.problem: Websites and SaaS are built for humans, block agents, and agents struggle to discover tools and provision services.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: WebMCP, Projects.dev, Zapier SDK, Ora Directory, Trace-Free+ tool description rewriting
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build agent-native provisioning, tool directories, access policies and tool-description optimizers.

agents & orchestration.title: Deterministic scaffolding around LLM steps
agents & orchestration.problem: Fully agentic workflows deviate and models don't follow long rules, so teams mix deterministic code with constrained LLM steps.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Stripe-style blueprints, validators, DAG orchestration, Orkes, SOPs, harness prompts
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a workflow builder that compiles repeated agent behavior into validated deterministic code.

agents & orchestration.title: Agent messaging and shared coordination state
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents need messaging, shared state and coordinated specialist networks, but frameworks are hierarchical and shared state gets overwritten.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Redis scratchpads, SQLite hive mind, JSON file messaging, Mastra, shared task boards, event-sourced logs
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a framework-agnostic coordination layer with atomic state, messaging bus, dispatch and audit/replay.

agents & orchestration.title: Credential isolation and login handling for agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents need account access without exposing passwords or running on escalated credentials, and browser agents hit login pages.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Auth proxies, 1Password for Agents, Composio Firewall, virtual cards, persistent browser profiles, Executor gateway
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a credential vault and session broker with per-agent, per-action scoped delegation.

agents & orchestration.title: Agent identity, trust and agent-only networks
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents need identities, credentials, payments and trusted messaging, and agent networks produce spam and unreadable chatter.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Agents handed cards and bank accounts, persistent agent identities
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build identity, payment, audit and filtering infrastructure for agent fleets and agent-to-agent interaction.

agents & orchestration.title: MCP statelessness and session state at scale
agents & orchestration.problem: MCP servers either spin up per conversation or keep state that breaks under concurrency. There is no standard persistent session storage, and some argue MCP is unnecessary.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Stateless MCP update, lazy tool loading, exposing HTTP APIs as MCP servers
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a session-state layer and hosting for stateless, horizontally scalable MCP servers, with converters from existing APIs.

agents & orchestration.title: OpenClaw security and runaway risks
agents & orchestration.problem: Personal agents have broad system access, leak data, spend credits and are open to prompt injection.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Docker, VMs, VPS isolation, Raspberry Pi hosting
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a hardened sandboxed personal agent with limited attack surface.

agents & orchestration.title: Multi-model councils and output verification
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents claim false success and output is hard to verify, so builders use critics, councils and voting.
agents & orchestration.who: developers and users needing reliable agent output
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Council of models, actor-critic in LangGraph, Planning Critic, verify-app subagent
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a verification layer sending work to separate critic models with voting and best-of-N selection.

agents & orchestration.title: MCP protocol gaps: client context, HTTP, annotations
agents & orchestration.problem: MCP lacks standard ways to pass client metadata such as timezone, and lacks official HTTP serving, tool annotations, staging, preflight and async tasks.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: FastMCP 2, MCP tasks, tools/resolve proposal
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build SDK helpers and gateways implementing these missing protocol patterns.

agents & orchestration.title: Governed MCP registry and enterprise agent management
agents & orchestration.problem: Enterprises need discovery, trust, identity, RBAC, audit and efficient tool loading for agents and MCP servers.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Runlayer, Metorial, Prefect Horizon, Claude Code MCP Tool Search, Cloudflare code-mode MCP server, LangSmith
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Provide a managed MCP gateway and registry with signatures, identity, audit logging and lazy tool loading.

agents & orchestration.title: Malformed and hallucinated tool calls
agents & orchestration.problem: Models hallucinate tools or emit malformed calls, breaking pipelines, and are mitigated mostly by prompts.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: OpenRouter response healing, preserved thought signatures, system prompt instructions
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a validator that checks calls against offered tools and repairs malformed output across providers.

agents & orchestration.title: DSPy production gaps
agents & orchestration.problem: DSPy users hit missing modules, provider gaps and history handling limits.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: dspy-cli, custom Adapters, llm-ax
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build DSPy extensions for trajectory injection, providers and deployment.

agents & orchestration.title: MCP connection failures and testing/debugging gaps
agents & orchestration.problem: MCP connections to clients are flaky, errors are opaque, and clients and inspectors have auth bugs and permissive schemas.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: ngrok or VPS workarounds
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build an MCP connection tester and validator with auth debugging, strict schema checks and security linting.

agents & orchestration.title: Physical-world and robotics agents
agents & orchestration.problem: LLMs are too slow and unreliable for real-world operations and robot control, so hybrids are needed.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: LLM planner with executor models, LLM plus VLA pairing

agents & orchestration.title: Agents show poor judgment and taste
agents & orchestration.problem: Agents over-bureaucratize, produce duplicates and miss quality problems, so humans must supply taste.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Separate audit agents, prompts against returning early

agents & orchestration.title: Parallel coding agents conflict on shared code
agents & orchestration.problem: Parallel mutating agents collide over files, branches and merges, and Git is not built for it.
agents & orchestration.who: developers running agent swarms on one codebase
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Worktrees, planning agents splitting non-overlapping chunks, Metaswarm
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a coordination layer with isolation, file locking and merge handling.

agents & orchestration.title: Manus reliability and automation complaints
agents & orchestration.problem: Manus users lose credits and work to failures, and automations degrade with updates without debugging access.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Switching to Manus 1.6 Max
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Offer a transparent, debuggable, versioned agent platform with CLI access.

agents & orchestration.title: Agent trace observability and long-trace review
agents & orchestration.problem: Long agent traces exceed judge contexts and make verification and transparency hard.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Traces, tool-call timelines, reviewer agents
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build trace review and judging tools for long runs.

agents & orchestration.title: Cost and loop guardrails for agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Retries and loops burn tokens unexpectedly and subscription limits mismatch agent workloads.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Iteration caps, token budgets, cost counters
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build budget and loop guardrails with per-run cost tracking.

agents & orchestration.title: Automatic skill creation and optimization
agents & orchestration.problem: Writing and tuning skills and prompts by hand is slow, and skills could be learned from workflows or traces.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: DSPy, GEPA, gskill, AgentHandover, EvoSkill, Hermes auto-skills
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a tool that records workflows and traces and turns them into optimized, versioned skills.

agents & orchestration.title: Issue-tracker-to-PR agent pipelines
agents & orchestration.problem: Teams want agents to handle tickets end to end with humans only writing specs and reviewing.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Symphony, GitHub issue loops, Ralph, BMAD
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build an issue-to-agent-to-PR pipeline with spec tooling and review gates.

agents & orchestration.title: Real-time voice agent harnesses
agents & orchestration.problem: Voice agents struggle with latency, interruptions, handoffs and lost terminology over long sessions.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Feather AI, Speechmatics, GPT-Realtime-2, Twilio
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a voice-agent harness with low latency, interruption handling and vocabulary retention.

agents & orchestration.title: Game-playing agent harnesses
agents & orchestration.problem: LLMs struggle with spatial reasoning, timing and game state, so game agents need purpose-built interfaces.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Grid overlays, chess engines for legal moves, MCP bridges
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a reusable game-agent harness exposing state, input timing and action tools.

agents & orchestration.title: Writing specs and delegation briefs for agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Users don't know what to ask agents and need clear specs, plans and done criteria.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Superpowers plugin, GSD framework, Conductor, PRD reuse
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build a spec and plan authoring tool that structures goals, limits and done criteria.

agents & orchestration.title: Runtime self-modifying apps and ontology grounding
agents & orchestration.problem: Memory files limit personalization, and agents could use ontologies and sandboxed extensions but these are burdensome to maintain.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Sandboxed extensions, agent-maintained ontology, RDF memory
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build safe runtime extension frameworks and ontology validation tooling for agents.

agents & orchestration.title: Remote control interfaces for agents
agents & orchestration.problem: Few good UIs exist for steering and monitoring agents remotely or deciding what to show users.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Claude Dispatch, Telegram bots, Slack-like apps
agents & orchestration.opportunity: Build interfaces for steering and monitoring agents remotely.

agents & orchestration.title: Agent output formats for humans
agents & orchestration.problem: Developers debate Markdown versus HTML as the agent-to-human layer.
agents & orchestration.current_solutions: Markdown for humans, HTML or AST for machines

consumer apps.title: Opaque subscription limits and silent model swaps
consumer apps.problem: Paid AI subscribers hit unclear, shifting usage caps and get silently downgraded or swapped models, so value per subscription is unpredictable. Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT free tiers all show this.
consumer apps.who: paying subscribers of Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT
consumer apps.current_solutions: Refreshing, switching providers, VPNs, manually selecting top models and extended thinking, direct Claude or OpenAI subscriptions
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a usage and model-transparency tracker and router that shows remaining quotas, which model answered, and remembers model selection across providers.

consumer apps.title: Chatbot tone, sycophancy and style control
consumer apps.problem: Chatbots are sycophantic, verbose, cold or abrasive, with grating tics, and custom instructions often fail to stick or persist across chats and models.
consumer apps.who: heavy chatbot users, especially ChatGPT users
consumer apps.current_solutions: Custom instructions, 'be concise' prompts, memory instructions, style settings, switching to Claude or Gemini
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a persistent tone and style layer that enforces user rules, strips tics and sycophancy, and tracks instruction adherence across models.

consumer apps.title: Filtering AI slop from feeds, search and forums
consumer apps.problem: AI-generated posts, spam and bot comments flood feeds, search, music and forums, and readers cannot tell human from AI content.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Pangram Chrome extension, hn-ai.org, hcker.news filter, invite-only communities, curated listening
consumer apps.opportunity: Build cross-platform extensions and human-verified spaces that score, filter or label AI-generated content.

consumer apps.title: Personal agent setup and always-on assistants
consumer apps.problem: Non-developers find proactive personal agents hard to host, set up and find uses for, and retention is weak.
consumer apps.current_solutions: OpenClaw, Clawdbot, Mac mini setups, cron agents, Zo Computer, Tasklet, Wabi, Instinct
consumer apps.opportunity: Build hosted one-click personal agents with onboarding and curated integrations.

consumer apps.title: Chatbot memory is leaky, stale and uneditable
consumer apps.problem: Chat memory leaks across projects, injects stale facts, loses history, creates lock-in and raises privacy worries, with no visible editable control.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Starting new chats, per-session memory toggles, memory export prompts, ChatGPT Projects
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a portable memory manager with inspection, scoped memory, pruning and chat backup and export across platforms.

consumer apps.title: Chatbot switching and model confusion
consumer apps.problem: Users move between ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini over ads, outages and personality, and cannot tell which model or mode they get; modes, names and plans are poorly documented.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Anthropic memory import, Kagi Assistant, Lumo, Inforno, OkeyBot
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a cross-chatbot hub that ports memory, compares assistants and recommends modes per task.

consumer apps.title: AI NPCs and bot-spoiled game multiplayer
consumer apps.problem: Game developers want small natural LLM NPCs and chat bots, but bots spoil leaderboards and behavior trees are brittle.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Gemma and Llama stream-chat bots, local LLM in Godot, separate bot rankings, LLM Mafia lobbies
consumer apps.opportunity: Build embeddable NPC models, SDKs and bot-segregated competition tools for game engines.

consumer apps.title: Gemini rollout, reliability and integration gaps
consumer apps.problem: Gemini access is capped or hard to buy, and it hallucinates, loses context, gives lazy answers, fails at browsing, lacks chat export and does not link well to Google data.
consumer apps.current_solutions: AI Studio instead of the app, Gemini Personal Intelligence beta, saved memory instructions

consumer apps.title: Social feeds lack user control
consumer apps.problem: Algorithmic feeds optimize for engagement, hide followed accounts, mix interests and feel generic.
consumer apps.current_solutions: TweetDeck search column, Twitter lists, Bluesky custom feeds, Sort by Recent
consumer apps.opportunity: Build tools for custom user-controlled feeds and mood-based filtering across platforms.

consumer apps.title: Voice agents lack natural turn-taking and realtime tooling
consumer apps.problem: Voice assistants interrupt, lag on tool calls and sound unnatural, and open cheap realtime stacks are lacking.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Cartesia, open-source speech-to-speech pipeline, GPT-Realtime-2, full-duplex models
consumer apps.opportunity: Offer open realtime voice components: streaming TTS, wake word, fast tool calling and barge-in.

consumer apps.title: AI health advice and triage is error-prone
consumer apps.problem: AI diagnosis and triage can be wrong, over-refer or be blocked, and laypeople struggle to guide chatbots on health, repair and legal questions.
consumer apps.who: consumers seeking medical, legal and personal advice
consumer apps.current_solutions: ChatGPT Health with medical records, Claude for home repair, personal health apps
consumer apps.opportunity: Build guided intake and triage assistants that cross-check sources and flag uncertainty.

consumer apps.title: Consumer computer-use and web agents blocked or unreliable
consumer apps.problem: Browser and computer-use agents are slow, risky and blocked by bot-hostile sites and long forms.
consumer apps.who: consumers wanting agents for everyday tasks
consumer apps.current_solutions: AutoGLM, CallMe for Claude Code, reverse-engineered APIs into MCP, markdown for agents
consumer apps.opportunity: Build reliable consumer computer-use agents with safe permissions and agent-ready site interfaces.

consumer apps.title: Chat text walls need generative interfaces
consumer apps.problem: Chat is a poor interface for travel, shopping, dating and complex thinking, and users want UI generated per task with control.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Gemini Dynamic View, Flipbook, OpenUI, ChatGPT Intelligent UI, interactive charts
consumer apps.opportunity: Build an open, controllable, model-agnostic generative-UI layer turning model output into structured interfaces.

consumer apps.title: Non-developers vibe coding personal apps
consumer apps.problem: Non-experts build apps with AI but cannot debug, host or share them, and personal agents remain technical.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Claude-built tools, hosted ChatGPT sites, Tasklet, Zo Computer
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a conversational builder with hosting, sharing and a store for micro-apps.

consumer apps.title: Personal finance, bill and subscription assistants
consumer apps.problem: Banking apps are poor and bills, subscriptions, taxes and planning are fragmented, while LLMs may be unreliable with money.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Attain Finance, ChatGPT finance preview, Tax UI, Perplexity tax agent, local LLM on own data
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a secure finance agent over bank data for budgeting, taxes and subscriptions with advisory-only AI.

consumer apps.title: Offline privacy-first voice and on-device AI apps
consumer apps.problem: Users want private, local transcription, TTS and assistant apps without subscriptions or cloud data sharing.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Spokenly with Parakeet, EasyWhisperUI, Kokoro Android reader, Private Notes, WisprFlow, AnythingLLM
consumer apps.opportunity: Build polished local-first dictation, TTS, document chat and journaling apps.

consumer apps.title: Roleplay and AI companion apps underserved
consumer apps.problem: Roleplay and companionship are large use cases, but existing apps feel shallow or manipulative, and no single model holds character well or allows mid-story switching.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Cherry Studio, SillyTavern, Character.ai, Tolan, Poe group chats, character cards
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a roleplay and companion front end with better memory, model switching, character card management and ethical retention.

consumer apps.title: AI writing detection and authorship verification
consumer apps.problem: Readers want to spot AI prose and writers want to prove or mask authorship, but detectors give false positives.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Pangram in Substack, semantic analysis, manual typing, instructing models to drop phrases
consumer apps.opportunity: Build authorship-verification and provenance tooling with low false positives.

consumer apps.title: Open-model chat front ends and aggregators
consumer apps.problem: HuggingChat is paywalled, OpenRouter's chat UI is buggy, and LMArena has captchas, logouts and missing stop or upload controls; users lack a good open-model chat app.
consumer apps.who: users of open-model chat UIs and arena tools
consumer apps.current_solutions: llumen, emailing billing support, mobile LMArena app suggestion
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a polished bring-your-own-key open-model chat and comparison app for mobile and web with stop controls and large-file handling.

consumer apps.title: Personal agent privacy, trust and permissions
consumer apps.problem: Personal agents want broad access to email, messages and finances, and have overreached or acted in wrong channels.
consumer apps.current_solutions: One-time Stripe Link cards, approval gates, isolated VMs and projects
consumer apps.opportunity: Build agents with scoped permissions, audit logs and approval gates.

consumer apps.title: Kimi chat app lacks organization features
consumer apps.problem: Kimi's app lacks projects, has short context, mixes memory across chats and has broken rendering, search and slides.
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a chat client with projects, isolated memory and reliable rendering over Kimi and other open models.

consumer apps.title: Overbroad guardrails and false-positive refusals
consumer apps.problem: Safety filters block harmless writing, image and health requests and sometimes ban accounts without recourse.
consumer apps.who: consumers using ChatGPT, custom GPTs and LMArena
consumer apps.current_solutions: Rewording prompts, RawChat stealth mode, incognito mode, free ChatGPT tier
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a refusal explainer, prompt-fix and appeals tool showing why a request was blocked and how to rephrase.

consumer apps.title: Consumer shopping and negotiating agents
consumer apps.problem: Agents can comparison shop and negotiate, but reliability, trust and fake discounts are concerns and agentic checkout converts poorly.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Universal Commerce Protocol, price-comparison Chrome plugin, Before You Buy
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a trusted shopping and negotiation agent that verifies deals.

consumer apps.title: Manus credits, billing and support failures
consumer apps.problem: Manus users report credits misapplied, payment failures, app size limits, crashes and slow or absent support.
consumer apps.opportunity: Offer a predictable-pricing agent service with clear credit accounting and responsive support.

consumer apps.title: AI Overviews errors and publisher traffic loss
consumer apps.problem: AI search summaries make false claims and cut click traffic for publishers.
consumer apps.opportunity: Offer search without AI overviews and monitor AI summaries of a brand.

consumer apps.title: DIY personal tracking and utility tools
consumer apps.problem: Consumers lack tools to track grocery prices and personal data, and want open small utilities for media, files and desktop tasks.
consumer apps.current_solutions: LLM-built grocery tracker, CLI file transfer, QR-code transfer, terminal video downloader
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a grocery price tracker and small open utilities for media libraries and file transfer.

consumer apps.title: Warm adjustable AI personality and companions
consumer apps.problem: Users who liked GPT-4o's warmth find newer models cold, and want tunable personality without sycophancy or harm to vulnerable users.
consumer apps.who: users wanting a warm AI companion
consumer apps.current_solutions: Custom instructions and presets, which do not replicate 4o
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a personality-control layer or companion app with tunable warmth that avoids sycophancy and checks in on users.

consumer apps.title: Perplexity Comet browser instability
consumer apps.problem: Perplexity's Comet AI browser is laggy, memory-hungry, lacks extensions, incognito and Linux support, and its agent features are unreliable.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Going back to Chrome
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a lightweight AI sidebar or extension adding reliable page reading and actions to existing browsers.

consumer apps.title: Minors, vulnerable users and AI companion over-trust
consumer apps.problem: Children, teens and vulnerable users can be harmed by chatbots that seem empathic and use engagement dark patterns.
consumer apps.opportunity: Build age assurance and parental control tooling for AI platforms.

consumer apps.title: Parental controls and child-safe media and AI
consumer apps.problem: Parents struggle to supervise children's screens, short-form content creeping into kids' apps, and AI chatbots and toys that may be unsafe.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Disabling Spotify video, whitelisting YouTube channels, moving playlists
consumer apps.opportunity: Build whitelist-based child-safe media curation, screen-time guardians and child-safe assistant layers.

consumer apps.title: Smart TV and car head unit debloating
consumer apps.problem: Smart TVs and Android car units push ads and telemetry and lag.
consumer apps.current_solutions: cleanyourtv, ADB debloating, custom launchers
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a safe launcher and telemetry blocker.

consumer apps.title: Personalized movie and music discovery
consumer apps.problem: Aggregate scores and streaming recommendations poorly predict personal taste and can spoil films.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Letterboxd, IMDb, Metacritic, Rotten Tomatoes, Spotify playlists
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a multi-dimensional, spoiler-free recommender.

consumer apps.title: Claude agent tools intimidate non-technical users
consumer apps.problem: Cowork and Claude Code expose technical files, hidden connectors and scary interfaces for non-developers.
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a friendly layer that surfaces connectors and hides code details.

consumer apps.title: Social coordination and friendship tools
consumer apps.problem: Hosting and keeping up friendships takes effort, and people turn to AI for simulated people.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Instinct group chat bot
consumer apps.opportunity: Build tools reducing coordination effort for friendships and events.

consumer apps.title: MCP and plugin connection in consumer chat apps
consumer apps.problem: Connecting MCP servers or plugins to consumer chat apps is fiddly and limited.
consumer apps.current_solutions: One-click OAuth MCP, app-store listings, Home Assistant MCP
consumer apps.opportunity: Build hosted one-click MCP connectors and a directory.

consumer apps.title: Ads and product placement in chatbot answers
consumer apps.problem: Chatbots may insert ads or sponsored content, and users want clear labeling or blocking.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Ad-free Claude positioning
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a browser extension that flags and blocks product placement in LLM responses.

consumer apps.title: Chatbot hallucination and fabrication
consumer apps.problem: ChatGPT and Gemini confidently fabricate and misdescribe files, so users must verify answers.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Manual verification, prompt-based honesty tricks
consumer apps.opportunity: Build an answer-verification layer that checks claims and flags fabricated file contents.

consumer apps.title: Dating apps lack feedback and good matching
consumer apps.problem: Dating apps rely on superficial filters, give little feedback and invite ghosting.
consumer apps.current_solutions: LLM-automated replies
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a dating or social-planning tool with feedback, commitment features and better matching.

consumer apps.title: Writer publishing friction on Substack and X
consumer apps.problem: Writers face unwanted embeds, utm links, domain blocking and low reach for long-form writing.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Claude Code Chrome extension for tables of contents and reposting
consumer apps.opportunity: Build tools fixing publishing quirks and adapting content to audiences.

consumer apps.title: Weak phone assistants like Siri
consumer apps.problem: Siri and on-device assistants are weak, so users build workarounds or want third-party model routing and voice Mac control.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Codex as voice assistant, Siri opening to ChatGPT and Claude
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a better voice assistant layer for phones and Macs.

consumer apps.title: Agent-readable websites and agent social platforms
consumer apps.problem: Websites are built for humans while agents parse them, and agent social networks suffer spam.
consumer apps.who: site owners and agent community builders
consumer apps.current_solutions: Tools scanning agent-friendliness of businesses
consumer apps.opportunity: Build tools making sites agent-readable and moderated agent platforms.

consumer apps.title: Engagement-optimized apps drive compulsive use
consumer apps.problem: Feeds, wearables and AI overlays hijack attention and cause dependence.
consumer apps.opportunity: Build commitment-device and attention-protection software.

consumer apps.title: Missing open APIs for consumer platforms
consumer apps.problem: Developers lack open APIs for Reddit, itch.io, sports data and telecom.
consumer apps.opportunity: Offer unofficial or aggregated API services.

consumer apps.title: Long chats slow down or lose context
consumer apps.problem: Long conversations get slow, truncated or summarized and lose early details across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Starting new chats, prompt caching, Gemini full-file ingestion
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a conversation manager that summarizes, branches and archives long chats while preserving key context.

consumer apps.title: Private social sharing for families
consumer apps.problem: Families want a private encrypted shared feed, but WhatsApp and Telegram fit poorly.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Signal and iMessage groups, shared iCloud albums, Google Photos shares
consumer apps.opportunity: Build an end-to-end encrypted private family feed app.

consumer apps.title: Shared home control devices
consumer apps.problem: Household members without devices lack easy access to home info and smart home control.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Apple smart home screens
consumer apps.opportunity: Build an affordable shared home display with voice.

consumer apps.title: Accessibility tools built with AI
consumer apps.problem: Disabled users need affordable custom interfaces, screen reader integration and camera assistants.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Custom AAC with ChatGPT, switch-accessible tools, Playwright agent browsing
consumer apps.opportunity: Build lightweight TTS for NVDA, text-first web and camera companions.

consumer apps.title: Weak retention and personalization in consumer AI
consumer apps.problem: Consumer AI products churn, and sign-in, persistent history and memory are key retention levers.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Sign-in and persistent chat history
consumer apps.opportunity: Build memory and personalization infrastructure for consumer AI apps.

consumer apps.title: Clean reading and recipe apps
consumer apps.problem: Users want clean RSS, read-it-later and recipe platforms free of ads and SEO clutter.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Shiori, Feedle
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a clean RSS reader and structured recipe platform.

consumer apps.title: Fragmented sports and streaming viewing
consumer apps.problem: Watching sports and TV needs many services, laggy apps and spoiler risk with no unified view.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Rotating subscriptions
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a unified where-to-watch guide that avoids spoilers.

consumer apps.title: Training environments and game creation tools
consumer apps.problem: Game and robotics teams pay vendors for interactive training worlds and want fast game state generation.
consumer apps.opportunity: Build on-demand environment generators from a stated goal.

consumer apps.title: Trustworthy information for seniors
consumer apps.problem: Seniors lack objective sources and face scams from unreliable search and social media.
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a local-first objective info product for seniors.

consumer apps.title: Open-source Perplexity-style answer engine
consumer apps.problem: Users unhappy with Perplexity's limits and quality want an open real-time search answer engine.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Perplexica on GitHub
consumer apps.opportunity: Build or host an open answer engine with generous limits.

consumer apps.title: Meal-prep and cooking coordination
consumer apps.problem: Cooking multiple recipes at once is chaotic, and LLM schedules ignore real constraints.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Prompting LLMs for recipes and timing schedules
consumer apps.opportunity: Build an app sequencing multiple recipes with constraints.

consumer apps.title: Ad-free mobile games and dark patterns
consumer apps.problem: Mobile games are full of ads and manipulative monetization.
consumer apps.opportunity: Publish ad-free games and a marketplace labeling monetization.

consumer apps.title: Missing consumer features in Claude
consumer apps.problem: Claude consumer demand spiked but it lacks features such as image generation.

consumer apps.title: Meeting recorders and proactive assistants lack context
consumer apps.problem: Meeting recorders and assistants could map people and context better and surface capabilities proactively.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Delphi digital twins, meeting-recording apps
consumer apps.opportunity: Build meeting apps mapping relationships and shared context.

consumer apps.title: Video generation continuity for creators
consumer apps.problem: Extending or keeping consistency across generated video clips degrades quality.
consumer apps.current_solutions: Last-frame-as-first-frame chaining, reference-to-video
consumer apps.opportunity: Build tools for consistent long-form video with character locking.

consumer apps.title: Verifying shared AI chat transcripts
consumer apps.problem: Shared LLM screenshots are doubted and there is no easy way to verify chats without exposing private data.
consumer apps.opportunity: Build a verifiable, redactable chat-sharing service.

business & markets.title: AI investment bubble and financing opacity
business & markets.problem: Observers cannot tell whether huge AI capex, debt and circular deals will pay off, and metrics like ARR obscure real performance.
business & markets.current_solutions: Cash-basis capex coverage metrics, gross profit per token
business & markets.opportunity: Build a dashboard tracking AI financing, circular dependencies and verified revenue.

business & markets.title: Expensive frontier models push users toward cost-aware routing
business & markets.problem: Frontier model prices and limits are high, and most workloads don't need top models, so builders struggle to pick the cheapest adequate model and keep unit economics healthy.
business & markets.who: developers and startups using frontier model APIs
business & markets.current_solutions: Switching to cheaper or open models like DeepSeek, Moonshot, Z.ai, GPT-5.2, Codex, Gemini; local models; flash tiers
business & markets.opportunity: Build a router that sends tasks to the cheapest model meeting a quality bar and tracks cost per task.

business & markets.title: Opaque AI subscription usage caps and missing mid-tier plans
business & markets.problem: Paying users of Claude, Perplexity, Kimi and similar plans hit hidden or quietly tightened caps, and the jump between tiers leaves no affordable middle option. Plan multipliers don't match real usage.
business & markets.who: heavy users, students and developers on AI subscriptions
business & markets.current_solutions: Splitting spend across providers, switching to Codex or Cursor, buying credits or resellers
business & markets.opportunity: Build a usage-limit tracker that normalizes quotas across plans and providers, alerts on changes, and compares or pools cheaper access.

business & markets.title: Usage and outcome-based AI pricing and billing infrastructure
business & markets.problem: Seat pricing breaks under AI and agents, token price doesn't reflect value, and flat-rate plans collapse under agentic workloads. Vendors lack clear billing abstractions.
business & markets.who: AI and SaaS vendors and their finance teams
business & markets.current_solutions: Per-resolved-ticket pricing, Devin ACUs, credits, flat-rate offers, metered pricing
business & markets.opportunity: Build pricing, metering and billing tooling for usage, outcome and hybrid flat-rate models with smart routing.

business & markets.title: LLM commoditization and weak moats
business & markets.problem: Models and thin wrappers are quickly copied, causing price wars and no durable advantage.
business & markets.current_solutions: Vertical workflows, proprietary data, enterprise contracts, moving up the stack

business & markets.title: Enterprise AI spend lacks ROI visibility
business & markets.problem: Companies burn token budgets without evidence of returns, and productivity gains don't show in company data or benchmarks.
business & markets.current_solutions: Token budgets, spending caps, Ramp AI Index
business & markets.opportunity: Build spend attribution and ROI benchmark dashboards linking token use to shipped output.

business & markets.title: Open-source and open-weight monetization and licensing
business & markets.problem: Open-source and open-weight projects struggle to fund themselves, and restrictive licenses, bans and distillation disputes create uncertainty.
business & markets.current_solutions: Enterprise support, open-core, Apache 2.0 relicensing, revenue-share licenses, fine-tuning services, micro-funding
business & markets.opportunity: Build licensing, revenue-share and micro-funding tools routing money to open-source and open-weight projects.

business & markets.title: AI-built products struggle to find users
business & markets.problem: Building is cheap so markets flood with products, and builders struggle to validate demand, get noticed and market.
business & markets.current_solutions: LinkedIn relationships, Show HN, bootstrapping
business & markets.opportunity: Build demand-validation and go-to-market tools that find users and avoid spam filters.

business & markets.title: AI-era sales, outreach and go-to-market tooling
business & markets.problem: Buyers research via AI, funnels are nonlinear, outreach sounds generic, and comp plans and usage revenue don't fit fast AI markets.
business & markets.who: sales and GTM teams at AI-era vendors
business & markets.current_solutions: Clay with QA rubrics, Concierge.ai, Attio MCP, Lightfield AI CRM, buying-signal detection
business & markets.opportunity: Build outreach, journey-tracking and usage-revenue forecasting tools that prepare vendor info for buyer agents.

business & markets.title: GPU compute markets and financing
business & markets.problem: Compute is illiquid, non-standard and costly, with no indexes, spot or futures markets for capacity.
business & markets.current_solutions: SF Compute futures, secured debt for bare metal, multi-year leases, prediction markets on compute
business & markets.opportunity: Build a compute exchange with standard SKUs, indexes and financing.

business & markets.title: Replacing SaaS with composable or in-house AI-built software
business & markets.problem: Users build their own tools or want unbundled blocks instead of bloated SaaS, but take on maintenance and security burdens.
business & markets.current_solutions: WorkOS, Stripe building blocks, API/CLI-first products, in-house tools
business & markets.opportunity: Build composable API-first alternatives and managed maintenance for AI-built internal tools.

business & markets.title: Lab financial fragility and subsidized pricing
business & markets.problem: Labs lose money, may seek government support, and subsidized inference makes real costs unclear, including data-for-discount tiers.
business & markets.current_solutions: Contributor tiers trading training data for cheaper tokens
business & markets.opportunity: Build a tool estimating true inference cost versus price and flagging subsidy risk.

business & markets.title: Silent AI plan changes and frontier models pulled to API-only
business & markets.problem: Vendors change pricing, plans and model access via tweets or stale docs, and move top models out of subscriptions on short notice, so users can't plan or trust costs.
business & markets.who: subscribers and builders relying on AI vendor plans
business & markets.current_solutions: Buying credits, third-party resellers, rerouting to other subscriptions
business & markets.opportunity: Build a service that diffs vendor pricing and plan pages, tracks model availability, alerts users and reroutes to cheapest access.

business & markets.title: Prepaid credits, gateways and closed-provider instability
business & markets.problem: Prepaid API credits expire, gateway payments and invoicing are painful, and abrupt closed-provider changes push users to seek stable alternatives that themselves face hikes.
business & markets.who: developers and institutions buying LLM API access
business & markets.current_solutions: OpenRouter, OpenCode with DeepSeek, token resellers, local inference
business & markets.opportunity: Offer a vendor-neutral multi-model gateway with stable pricing, non-expiring balances, invoicing and human support.

business & markets.title: Monetizing consumer AI chatbots with ads
business & markets.problem: Free chat users rarely pay, so AI apps need monetization without degrading the experience, and users fear ads in ChatGPT.
business & markets.who: AI app builders and consumer chatbot users
business & markets.current_solutions: Koah native ads, ad plus $10 subscription hybrid, native ads in conversations
business & markets.opportunity: Build ad networks or ad-funded AI services and ad tools for agentic apps.

business & markets.title: Cursor and Manus billing, credit burn and refund confusion
business & markets.problem: Users of AI coding and agent tools face opaque credit deductions, surprise invoices, expiring credits, billing errors and poor support or refunds when outputs fail.
business & markets.who: users of Cursor, Manus and other credit-based AI tools
business & markets.current_solutions: Creating multiple accounts, switching to cheaper alternatives
business & markets.opportunity: Build a cost monitor with spend caps, credit previews and consolidated billing views, plus test-based refund evidence.

business & markets.title: Vendor trust and gating of frontier models
business & markets.problem: Government actions against vendors erode trust in the US AI stack, and labs debate withholding top models and open-weight releases.

business & markets.title: Clinical trial and FDA bottlenecks
business & markets.problem: Trials are costly, rebuilt from scratch and slowed by IRBs and FDA uncertainty even when AI speeds discovery.
business & markets.current_solutions: AI-guided experimentation tooling
business & markets.opportunity: Build standardized reusable trial infrastructure that makes trials cheaper and faster.

business & markets.title: Policy debates: robotaxis, fertility, wealth tax, chips, housing
business & markets.problem: Regulatory and policy disputes over robotaxis, fertility costs, wealth taxes, Nvidia China exports and housing rules remain unsettled.
business & markets.current_solutions: Building 99-unit buildings

business & markets.title: Agent payment rails and wallets
business & markets.problem: Agents need to pay in real time without exposing card details, and card rails don't support micro-transactions.
business & markets.current_solutions: x402, Coinbase Agentic Wallets, stablecoins, agentcard.sh, Stripe Machine Payments Protocol
business & markets.opportunity: Build agent wallet, one-time credential and micropayment tooling with spending controls.

business & markets.title: Data center local opposition
business & markets.problem: Local opposition over water, electricity bills and noise delays AI data centers, often on exaggerated claims.
business & markets.opportunity: Build tools that share compute revenue with local communities.

business & markets.title: AI agent liability and insurance
business & markets.problem: Liability for agent purchases is unclear, agent risks are uninsured and existing insurance doesn't fit.
business & markets.opportunity: Build insurance and underwriting tools for agent deployments.

business & markets.title: AI startup funding and go-to-market gaps
business & markets.problem: AI startups raise large rounds without clear plans and struggle with profitability and repeatable revenue.

business & markets.title: Prediction market integrity and question gaps
business & markets.problem: Prediction markets are dominated by sports and crypto, prone to insider trading, and analysts lack baselines to detect it.
business & markets.current_solutions: Unusual Whales Polymarket scanner
business & markets.opportunity: Build insider-detection analytics and platforms for long-term conditional questions.

business & markets.title: Micropayments and creator revenue
business & markets.problem: Consumers stack small subscriptions, and creators, writers and social users lack pay-per-consumption and sustainable payouts.
business & markets.current_solutions: Substack paid tier, paywalling
business & markets.opportunity: Build a pay-per-consumption micropayment system for creators.

business & markets.title: Free tier cuts and Hugging Face paywall problems
business & markets.problem: Providers cut free tiers or impose limits due to inference costs, and some users hit payment failures and paywalls.

business & markets.title: Simulation tools for decisions and policy
business & markets.problem: Single-metric analysis misses second-order effects of launches, pricing and fiscal plans.
business & markets.opportunity: Build agent-based simulation tools testing campaigns and policies.

business & markets.title: Vertical AI agents selling outcomes
business & markets.problem: Professions want packaged agent services rather than raw tools.
business & markets.current_solutions: Cowork vertical workflows, Ramp Stack, AI rollups
business & markets.opportunity: Build outcome-selling vertical agents for specific professions.

business & markets.title: Venture liquidity and pre-IPO price discovery
business & markets.problem: Private companies stay private, LPs get few distributions, secondary liquidity concentrates in few names, and pre-IPO prices are hard to see.
business & markets.who: investors, LPs and employees of private companies
business & markets.current_solutions: Tender offers, continuation vehicles, Forge, Industry Ventures, Hyperliquid stock perpetuals
business & markets.opportunity: Build secondary marketplace and pre-IPO price aggregation tools.

business & markets.title: App-layer margins and AI unit economics
business & markets.problem: Application companies depend on token costs they don't control and can't see their margins.
