business & markets.current_solutions: Outcome-based or high monthly pricing
business & markets.opportunity: Build tools for token gross margin and unit economics across providers.

business & markets.title: AI finance dashboards
business & markets.problem: People want AI to track finances and model scenarios, despite doubts on accounting rigor and data costs.
business & markets.current_solutions: Personal AI CFO, Silvia dashboard, Finnhub
business & markets.opportunity: Build an AI finance dashboard with what-if modeling.

business & markets.title: Generative Engine Optimization brand tracking
business & markets.problem: Marketers lack guidance on getting brands recommended by LLMs as clicks fall.
business & markets.current_solutions: Structured data, comparison docs, third-party mentions
business & markets.opportunity: Build a GEO monitor tracking brand mentions across LLMs.

business & markets.title: Philanthropic grant discovery and funder coordination
business & markets.problem: Funders struggle to find and evaluate grants because information is scattered and pitches are adversarial.
business & markets.current_solutions: Lightcone Commons, S-Process, retroactive funding
business & markets.opportunity: Build a neutral platform aggregating grantee information and coordinating funders.

business & markets.title: Manus users fear Meta acquisition
business & markets.problem: Users worry the acquisition will degrade the product and endanger data and privacy.

business & markets.title: Anthropic blocks third-party harness subscription use
business & markets.problem: Anthropic restricted subscription use in tools like OpenClaw, forcing extra bundles or API keys while OpenAI allows it.
business & markets.current_solutions: Extra usage bundles, API keys

business & markets.title: Marketplace for scientific experiments
business & markets.problem: Scarce lab resources need allocation to AI-generated research ideas.
business & markets.opportunity: Build a marketplace to propose, price and run experiments.

business & markets.title: Perplexity referral bans and unpaid payouts
business & markets.problem: Referral program users are banned for alleged fraud with payouts canceled or stuck and no working appeal path.
business & markets.who: affiliates and referrers of AI product programs
business & markets.opportunity: Build a payout tracker or dispute service for AI referral programs.

business & markets.title: Hedging AI infrastructure exposure
business & markets.problem: Investors want ways to hedge or short AI spending and buy distressed assets after a bust.
business & markets.current_solutions: Cash, gold, small cap value, treasuries, short interest
business & markets.opportunity: Build analytics for AI-exposed short interest and distressed GPU assets.

business & markets.title: Ride and delivery fraud detection
business & markets.problem: Platforms miss impossible trips and mishandle driver fraud claims.
business & markets.opportunity: Build trip anomaly detection for ride-hailing billing.

business & markets.title: AI chip diversion tracking
business & markets.problem: Chip smuggling to restricted entities is hard to detect.
business & markets.current_solutions: Analysts reconstruct networks from public filings
business & markets.opportunity: Build a tool tracking ownership of AI chip purchases.

business & markets.title: Legacy CPQ breaks under modern pricing
business & markets.problem: CPQ tools can't handle consumption pricing, bundles and SKU sprawl.
business & markets.current_solutions: Legacy CPQ tools
business & markets.opportunity: Build an AI-native CPQ and quoting product.

business & markets.title: Sales commission cash flow modeling
business & markets.problem: Discounts and cancellations force startups to pay commissions before cash arrives, with unclear clawbacks.
business & markets.opportunity: Build a commission and payment-terms cash flow modeling tool.

business & markets.title: Data labeling and dataset valuation
business & markets.problem: Founders need human labeling alternatives and ways to value proprietary datasets.
business & markets.current_solutions: Scale AI
business & markets.opportunity: Build a human data-labeling service or dataset valuation tool.

business & markets.title: AI shopping assistants
business & markets.problem: Retailers and users want chat-style shopping assistants that drive sales.
business & markets.current_solutions: Amazon Rufus, Perplexity shopping with PayPal

business & markets.title: Copyright and licensing for AI training
business & markets.problem: Creators lack clarity and collective licensing for AI use of their work.
business & markets.opportunity: Build licensing or collective rights platforms.

business & markets.title: Small merchant storefront simulation testing
business & markets.problem: Small merchants lack traffic for A/B testing.
business & markets.current_solutions: SimGym simulation
business & markets.opportunity: Build simulation-based storefront testing tools.

business & markets.title: Forward-deployed engineering for AI labs
business & markets.problem: Labs need forward-deployed engineering at scale without diluting headcount.
business & markets.current_solutions: Google Cloud partner funding, acquiring consultancies such as Tomoro

enterprise adoption.title: Frontier model churn, deprecations and vendor lock-in
enterprise adoption.problem: Models change, get deprecated or repriced, and providers can be banned, cut off by export controls or fail. Switching requires re-evaluation and pipeline rewrites, and buyers lack multi-vendor routing and task-specific evals.
enterprise adoption.who: enterprises and builders dependent on hosted AI models
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Multi-model platforms like TELUS Fuel iX; multi-vendor fallbacks; backup contracts with non-US vendors; open-weight models on alternative hardware; EU-hosted alternatives; Microsoft hosting Claude.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a model-agnostic gateway with routing, failover, version pinning, regression testing and task-specific evaluation.

enterprise adoption.title: Agent identity, permissions and governance
enterprise adoption.problem: Enterprises lack identity, scoped access, policy enforcement and audit logging for AI agents touching many systems, including bank accounts. Prompt-based policy fails.
enterprise adoption.who: enterprise security and platform teams, banks
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Descope agent IAM; digital employee setups at banks; sandboxed Cowork VM; Cloudflare AI Gateway; enterprise-managed MCP auth.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build an agent control plane with identity, scoped authorization, policy enforcement and audit that plugs into existing security tools.

enterprise adoption.title: Organizations can't redesign workflows or scale AI adoption
enterprise adoption.problem: Organizational structure, workflows and norms lag model capability, so adoption stays with early adopters. Managers struggle with use-case discovery and change management.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Sharing internal AI examples; forward deployed engineers; agent captains and shared skills repos; dedicated frontier teams; role-specific plugins; AI teammates in Slack.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Offer a tool or service that maps workflows, surfaces AI use cases, and guides onboarding and process redesign.

enterprise adoption.title: Mandated AI usage and low-quality AI output erode trust
enterprise adoption.problem: Mandates, usage KPIs and hiring freezes lead to gaming, wasted automation and resentment. Unreviewed AI output pasted by colleagues erodes trust and burdens reviewers.
enterprise adoption.who: employees, engineers and managers under AI mandates
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Employees log in daily to inflate usage counts.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Provide adoption analytics measuring real value, plus tools that attribute and verify AI-generated work and support review.

enterprise adoption.title: Private and on-prem LLMs for sensitive data
enterprise adoption.problem: Organizations with sensitive or regulated data want local or private models trained on company data but face data-sharing, compute, tooling and hardware reliability hurdles.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Pharma consortium co-funding an open model; adapting open-weight bases; Ollama; Open WebUI with Mistral; Kimi and Qwen; cloud/local workload split.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Provide a turnkey stack for fine-tuning and deploying private models with routing, traces, sandboxing and governance.

enterprise adoption.title: Enterprise AI pilots show no measurable ROI
enterprise adoption.problem: Companies report little measurable return on generative AI spend, pilots stall, and individual gains don't scale to the organization. Few track AI impact metrics, and studies conflict.
enterprise adoption.who: enterprise executives and AI program owners
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Measuring minutes saved per workflow; Cognition's productivity guarantee.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build tooling that measures AI usage against shipped outcomes and workflow time savings, and tracks pilot-to-production progress.

enterprise adoption.title: Production agent reliability and oversight
enterprise adoption.problem: Agent errors and liability demand evals, reliability thresholds, audit-ready verification and humans in the loop, as model reliability lags capability.
enterprise adoption.who: teams running agents in production workflows
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Human in the loop; separating augmentation from automation; forward-deployed engineers; human approval of agent proposals.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build context-specific agent evaluation, verification and audit tooling.

enterprise adoption.title: AI inference spend and token cost control
enterprise adoption.problem: Token usage grows quickly, budgets are exceeded, and companies cannot cap, allocate or justify spend across tools and users.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Per-employee caps (Uber); rationing by role; routing to cheaper models; cutting tools; Shopify moved DSPy logic to a smaller model.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a cross-vendor spend governance dashboard with budgets, quotas, tiering and cost-aware routing.

enterprise adoption.title: Clinician documentation and prior-auth burden
enterprise adoption.problem: Clinicians face heavy documentation, alert fatigue and prior authorization friction, reject tools that add EHR clicks, and need local guidelines integrated.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: HIPAA-ready ChatGPT for Clinicians; ambient scribes; manually embedded local guidelines.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build EHR-embedded tools automating documentation and prior auth with no added clicks and local guideline integration.

enterprise adoption.title: Legal AI is hard to verify and trust
enterprise adoption.problem: Lawyers lack access, use cases and trust; verification eats productivity, and agents rarely complete full legal and financial workflows correctly.
enterprise adoption.who: lawyers and legal and financial teams
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Harvey workflows and Harvey Labs evals; Gemini highlighted citations; hybrid agent routing.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build legal AI with cheap verification: highlighted citations, Westlaw/Lexis connections, provenance, audit and eval tooling.

enterprise adoption.title: Tacit knowledge and company brain for agents
enterprise adoption.problem: Business rules and context live in meetings, email and heads, so agents lack requirements; teams want a shared agent with governed organizational memory.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Context databases; MCP connections to Slack and Drive; forward deployed engineers; Airbnb Everest context graph; Indent; Atlas.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a company brain that captures institutional knowledge with permission-aware memory for agents.

enterprise adoption.title: AI usage restrictions in contracts are unverifiable
enterprise adoption.problem: Buyers and vendors cannot verify or enforce usage restrictions, 'all lawful use' language is ambiguous, and contracts are confidential.
enterprise adoption.who: AI vendors, government buyers and policy observers
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Safety stacks, forward-deployed engineers, contract carve-outs.

enterprise adoption.title: Legacy system and COBOL modernization lacks business-rule knowledge
enterprise adoption.problem: Migration stalls because business logic is undocumented, scale is huge, AI output needs line-level review, and environments are air-gapped. Agents miss subtle business rules.
enterprise adoption.who: enterprises with legacy mainframe and ERP systems
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Business rule extraction with AI.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a business-rule extraction and system-understanding tool that runs in restricted environments.

enterprise adoption.title: Data retention conflicts and vendor data-extraction fears
enterprise adoption.problem: Provider retention (e.g. 30 days) conflicts with enterprise zero-retention policies, zero-retention tiers cost a premium, and enterprises fear vendors learn from proprietary data.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Anthropic lets enterprises take on retention themselves; zero-retention at a premium.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a compliance layer that proxies and audits retention across providers and guarantees vendors have no data access.

enterprise adoption.title: Agent risk verification and AI vendor due diligence
enterprise adoption.problem: Risk leaders lack ways to verify agent risk and evaluate AI vendors, so pilots stall, and startups lack credible security trust signals.
enterprise adoption.who: risk and security leaders, AI startups
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a standard AI vendor assessment, certification or insurance product.

enterprise adoption.title: Enterprises need forward-deployed engineers to deploy AI
enterprise adoption.problem: Most enterprises cannot install and customize AI without embedded engineers, and the FDE role is vaguely defined and hard to scale.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: FDEs reporting into product; legal engineers on shared primitives; bespoke integrations.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build tooling and managed services that productize last-mile customization and deployment.

enterprise adoption.title: Open models blocked by provenance or license concerns
enterprise adoption.problem: Provenance concerns and restrictive licenses slow enterprise adoption of strong open models, with few trusted Western alternatives.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Openness index to classify licenses.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build tooling to classify license and provenance risk and ease compliance for open models.

enterprise adoption.title: AI security operations and vulnerability triage
enterprise adoption.problem: Security teams are overwhelmed by alerts and vulnerabilities that humans cannot triage at attack speed.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build AI tools for alert triage, vulnerability prioritization, pen testing and threat intelligence.

enterprise adoption.title: Customer support bots trap users without human escalation
enterprise adoption.problem: Support bots loop customers, miss emergencies and accents, and lack escalation paths, damaging brand trust.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Hybrid models; Fin, Sierra, Vercel agents; LLM ticket summarization.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build support agents with reliable escalation, emergency detection and handoff.

enterprise adoption.title: Role-specific AI bundles and sandboxes for employees
enterprise adoption.problem: Employees wait on IT approvals and face fragmented tools, while enterprises want ready-made role-specific AI products.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: TELUS sandbox for 30,000 employees; Menlo finding on ready-made products.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Offer plug-and-play role-specific AI bundles with central controls.

enterprise adoption.title: Government vendor-risk designations disrupt AI contractors
enterprise adoption.problem: Supply chain risk designations and broad procurement terms force contractors to audit, certify and swap AI vendor exposure quickly.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Dual technology stacks; narrow API-level restrictions.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build tooling that inventories AI vendor dependencies across a supply chain and automates certification.

enterprise adoption.title: Replacing SaaS with in-house AI-built tools
enterprise adoption.problem: Teams build bespoke CRMs and replace SaaS with AI-coded tools, raising concerns about fragility and customization limits.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Google Sheets plus LLM outreach; in-house replacements for Intercom, Zendesk.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Provide platforms for building and maintaining internal business tools with AI.

enterprise adoption.title: Data center community opposition
enterprise adoption.problem: Local communities oppose data centers and permitting slows buildout.

enterprise adoption.title: Procurement processes poorly fit AI model buying
enterprise adoption.problem: Tender-based procurement and slow approvals lead to poorly fitting software and delayed adoption of cheaper models.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: AWS Marketplace consolidated billing.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build procurement tools that score models on values, alignment and fit.

enterprise adoption.title: Subscription limits and third-party harness blocks
enterprise adoption.problem: Subscription plans cut limits or block third-party harnesses, forcing users onto costlier API billing.

enterprise adoption.title: Frontier model access gated to few organizations
enterprise adoption.problem: Most capable models are released only to select partners or after consumer apps, leaving developers without access.

enterprise adoption.title: Selling AI to enterprises is slow
enterprise adoption.problem: AI startups face long sales cycles and buyer AI usage adds delays, while traditional SaaS sales motions no longer fit.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Design partners; PE portfolio rollouts.

enterprise adoption.title: Packaged AI for drug and materials discovery
enterprise adoption.problem: Non-computational scientists find structure prediction tools costly and hard to run, and domain adoption requires collaboration.
enterprise adoption.who: bench scientists in biotech and materials
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Integrations with PubMed, Benchling; hosted APIs.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Provide packaged APIs and agent pipelines for protein and molecule design.

enterprise adoption.title: Shadow AI and unsanctioned employee-built tools
enterprise adoption.problem: Employees use personal AI subscriptions or build unsanctioned tools that bypass governance and create security flaws.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a sanctioned platform and scanner for employee-built AI tools.

enterprise adoption.title: Nationality verification for AI access
enterprise adoption.problem: AI providers cannot verify users' citizenship at scale, making nationality-based access restrictions impractical.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build a KYC and nationality verification service for gating AI model API access.

enterprise adoption.title: Robotics deployment costs and integration
enterprise adoption.problem: Robot deployments need heavy integration, setup and teleoperation beyond sticker price.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Teleoperation

enterprise adoption.title: Enterprise MCP needs auth and central management
enterprise adoption.problem: MCP adoption lacks enterprise-grade authentication, mTLS and central discovery, leading to duplicate servers.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Internal MCP servers for Slack and Linear; centralized gateways.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build an enterprise MCP gateway with auth, registry and policy.

enterprise adoption.title: AI agents for finance and back-office workflows
enterprise adoption.problem: Finance teams burn manpower on bespoke payroll, AP and compliance processes.
enterprise adoption.current_solutions: Anthropic finance agent templates; Brex audit agents.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build finance automation agents for AP, close and expense audit.

enterprise adoption.title: AI tools for government policy analysis
enterprise adoption.problem: Policymakers lack AI analyst tools, and congressional IT policies limit AI use.
enterprise adoption.opportunity: Build policy-analyst AI tools meeting government security requirements.

local & open models.title: On-device, mobile and edge small model deployment
local & open models.problem: Phones and edge devices can run small models, but setup, conversion tooling, memory, power and capability are limiting.
local & open models.who: Mobile and edge developers and enthusiasts
local & open models.current_solutions: llama.cpp in Termux, Liquid LFM, FunctionGemma, Cactus, Gemma 4 E2B/E4B, Google AI Edge Gallery, Bonsai 1-bit, MLX-VLM, Mirai.
local & open models.opportunity: Conversion and deployment pipelines and runtimes that move small models to phones and edge hardware offline.

local & open models.title: Western versus Chinese open models and openness debates
local & open models.problem: Open-model leadership, transparency, parity with closed models and strategy are contested, with US models lagging Chinese ones and new releases claiming near-frontier capability.
local & open models.who: Observers and builders following open models

local & open models.title: Running huge open models on Macs, limited VRAM and clusters
local & open models.problem: Trillion-parameter and giant MoE models exceed consumer RAM and VRAM, requiring offloading, SSD streaming, heavy quantization or multi-device clusters with complex setup.
local & open models.who: Enthusiasts running large open models on Macs and consumer GPUs
local & open models.current_solutions: Exo Labs with MLX RDMA over Thunderbolt 5, MLX Distributed, CPU expert offload, SSD expert streaming, dynamic 2-bit quants, llama.cpp RPC, custom C engines, ClusterChat.
local & open models.opportunity: Turnkey tooling that automates expert offload and prefetching, SSD streaming, GPU pooling and cluster orchestration across consumer devices.

local & open models.title: Missing mid-size open models for consumer hardware
local & open models.problem: Users want models between small and huge, such as 9B for 8GB VRAM, 27B-100B for 24GB GPUs or 120B MoE for 96-128GB Macs, with GGUF builds, but trillion-scale releases are too large.
local & open models.who: Local users with consumer GPUs and Macs
local & open models.current_solutions: Qwen3.5 medium models, Qwen3 MoE variants, LFM2-24B, smaller Qwen 27B, Nemotron, 1-bit quants.

local & open models.title: Local versus cloud economics and cost hedging
local & open models.problem: Per-token API costs, subscription limits and price hikes push users toward local or open models, but it is unclear whether local is cheaper given hardware and electricity.
local & open models.who: Developers and teams weighing hosted APIs against local hardware
local & open models.current_solutions: Dual 3090 rigs, $4k hardware at 50M tokens/day, Asus GX10 and DGX Spark, free Gemma, DeepSeek/GLM alternatives, Chinese provider plans, OpenRouter, hybrid setups.
local & open models.opportunity: Cost calculators and comparison tools showing break-even and savings of local or open models versus hosted APIs.

local & open models.title: Unreliable tool calling and loops in local models
local & open models.problem: Open and small models ignore tool results, emit raw tool tokens, choose wrong tools, loop, drift in context and break on parsers and chat templates. Buggy chat templates cause failures users patch by hand.
local & open models.who: Developers running local agents
local & open models.current_solutions: Re-enforcing tools in system prompts, matching call formats, scaffolds like pi and little-coder, Q8 weights, tuned sampling, community-patched Jinja templates, Unsloth template fixes.
local & open models.opportunity: A tool-call compatibility layer, eval suite and chat template validator/registry with loop detection and guardrails.

local & open models.title: Private local AI for sensitive and personal work
local & open models.problem: People need to process private or sensitive content such as email, medical, finance and security data without sending it to cloud providers, and hosted models may refuse security analysis.
local & open models.who: Professionals and individuals with confidential data
local & open models.current_solutions: Local Gemma/Qwen, on-prem medical models, offline apps, llama.cpp, Ollama, local-first agents, self-hosted GLM-5.2.
local & open models.opportunity: Private offline assistants and packaged local stacks for email, medical, security and document tasks, including private fine-tuning.

local & open models.title: Reasoning loops and overthinking in local models
local & open models.problem: Open reasoning models loop, overthink and burn tokens and context, taking minutes to hours, and recommended sampler settings or default effort can cause doom loops on consumer hardware.
local & open models.who: Users of local reasoning models
local & open models.current_solutions: System prompts separating thinking from output, sampler tweaks, reasoning off toggles, negative logit bias, effort control templates.
local & open models.opportunity: Per-model presets and an adaptive reasoning controller that caps thinking by task.

local & open models.title: One-click local model installers and GUI managers
local & open models.problem: Installing, running and managing local models and server configs remains too technical, fragile and costly for casual users.
local & open models.who: Non-technical and desktop users of local LLMs
local & open models.current_solutions: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.app, TextGen, Unsloth Desktop, Nativ, llama.cpp web UI, ggml joining Hugging Face.
local & open models.opportunity: A consumer-friendly app or appliance with model discovery, simple selection, memory estimates, configs and MCP tooling.

local & open models.title: Policy and supply gap for US open models
local & open models.problem: US builders lack current frontier-quality open bases, and there is debate over restricting open weights given misuse risks and unrecallable releases.
local & open models.who: US builders and policymakers
local & open models.current_solutions: Nemotron Coalition, Gemma, OpenAI and Ai2 open releases, Arcee, staged release, pre-release red-teaming.

local & open models.title: Quantization quality is opaque and hard to compare
local & open models.problem: Quant quality varies by model, method and publisher, and publishers report little beyond perplexity or KLD, which don't predict task performance. Same-named quants differ and bit levels are often unspecified.
local & open models.who: Local model users choosing GGUF/quant variants
local & open models.current_solutions: Community KL divergence and perplexity comparisons, Unsloth dynamic GGUFs and calibration updates, QAT checkpoints, ISTA and ByteShape suites, using Q8 for coding.
local & open models.opportunity: A quant benchmarking service reporting per-task accuracy, KV-cache effects, exact specs and size/speed/quality tradeoffs per model.

local & open models.title: Moving workloads from frontier to local models by routing
local & open models.problem: Teams want to cut hosted-model costs by sending simple or high-volume tasks to cheap local or distilled models and reserving frontier models for hard tasks, but lack good routers.
local & open models.who: Teams and developers with hosted-model costs
local & open models.current_solutions: Replaying task data through open models, fine-tuning small Qwen3 models, BERT classifiers, task routers, Needle router, semantic routing with small Gemma, Ollama cloud burst, planner/executor splits.
local & open models.opportunity: A router and distillation pipeline that classifies task difficulty, dispatches between local and cloud, and evaluates cheaper replacements.

local & open models.title: Local coding models still weaker than frontier cloud
local & open models.problem: Local models on consumer hardware are too slow, need heavy prompt engineering, and are too weak to replace Claude Code or Codex for heavy coding.
local & open models.who: Developers trying to replace cloud coding agents with local models
local & open models.current_solutions: Hybrid cloud plus local setups, modified system prompts, disabling thinking, Qwen3.5/3.6 27B-35B, Gemma 4, 64GB+ memory.
local & open models.opportunity: Honest benchmarks and recommended configurations showing where local coding breaks down.

local & open models.title: Matching models to hardware, VRAM and speed
local & open models.problem: Users cannot easily tell which models and quantizations fit and run well on their RAM, VRAM or Mac, and VRAM calculators often don't support GGUF. Existing tools over-promise speed.
local & open models.who: Local LLM users picking models for their hardware
local & open models.current_solutions: LLmFit, canirun.ai, VRAM calculators, hf CLI extension, Hugging Face hardware filters, Pipette eval suite, LM Studio memory estimates, manual offload tuning.
local & open models.opportunity: A hardware-aware model finder and VRAM estimator supporting GGUF and MLX, multi-GPU, and prompt-processing speed with standardized benchmarks.

local & open models.title: Local coding agent setup with Claude Code, OpenCode, Cline
local & open models.problem: Developers want agentic coding on local models, but integrations are fiddly and the models are slow or unreliable. Local models often output code in chat instead of editing files, and loop or bloat tokens.
local & open models.who: Developers running coding agents on local models
local & open models.current_solutions: LM Studio Anthropic-compatible endpoint, llama-server with Claude Code, OpenCode, Roo, Cline, Ollama integrations, Pi harness, loop detection, forced subagents.
local & open models.opportunity: A packaged local coding-agent harness that configures server, model and tool parser together and edits files reliably.

local & open models.title: Finding good uncensored and abliterated local models
local & open models.problem: Users want capable low-refusal models, but many abliterated variants lose quality, setup is overwhelming, and safeguard removal raises safety concerns.
local & open models.who: Local model users wanting low-refusal models for roleplay, privacy or control
local & open models.current_solutions: OBLITERATUS, Heretic, LoRA on Josiefied models, derestricted Qwen GGUFs, KoboldCPP with SillyTavern.
local & open models.opportunity: A benchmark and curated directory of uncensored models showing the refusal versus capability tradeoff, with verified tools.

local & open models.title: Private local search, RAG, memory and knowledge packs
local & open models.problem: Local models need private search, retrieval, persistent memory and current knowledge, ideally without bulky RAG or context stuffing.
local & open models.who: Users of offline local assistants
local & open models.current_solutions: DuckDuckGo MCP with searxng, Ollama embeddings with LanceDB, sqlite-vec, browser MCP extension, n-gram memory injection in llama.cpp.
local & open models.opportunity: A packaged local-first assistant with search, RAG, memory and downloadable knowledge packs.

local & open models.title: New open model launches lack runtime support and have bugs
local & open models.problem: New open models ship with broken or missing runtime support, buggy GGUFs, tokenizer and template errors, forcing forks, re-downloads and manual flags and wasting days of setup.
local & open models.who: Early adopters of new open models
local & open models.current_solutions: Day-one support across vLLM, GGUF and LM Studio, llama.cpp fixes, forks, community GGUFs, manual chat templates and sampler flags.
local & open models.opportunity: A compatibility tracker and automated pipeline that tracks runtime support, applies correct templates and publishes compatible GGUFs.

local & open models.title: Long context and multi-turn degradation in local models
local & open models.problem: Small and local models drift, repeat and lose context in long chats or large retrieval contexts, and KV cache memory and prefill cost limit long context on consumer hardware.
local & open models.who: Local model users with long conversations or large contexts
local & open models.current_solutions: Chunking, summarization, top-k tuning, q4_1 or Q8 KV cache, sparse attention, vision projector on CPU.
local & open models.opportunity: Memory and context management tooling that estimates budgets and recommends context and KV settings.

local & open models.title: Access and archiving risk for Chinese open weights
local & open models.problem: Users fear export or access restrictions on Chinese open models and want mirrors, plus trusted domestic alternatives.
local & open models.who: Users and teams relying on Chinese open weights
local & open models.current_solutions: Local archiving, torrents, Mistral alternatives.
local & open models.opportunity: Build a mirror and archive service for open weights.

local & open models.title: Local inference speedups: speculative decoding and optimized runtimes
local & open models.problem: Local generation is slow, especially for dense 27-31B models, and users hunt for decoding speedups and better-tuned runtimes.
local & open models.who: Local inference users on consumer GPUs and Apple Silicon
local & open models.current_solutions: MTP speculative decoding in llama.cpp, ngram-mod drafting, MLX backend for Ollama, DFlash, Metal kernels, Uzu, oMLX, ExLlamaV3.
local & open models.opportunity: A one-click optimized runtime that auto-applies speculative decoding, MTP quants and kernel tuning.

local & open models.title: Local speech-to-text and voice apps
local & open models.problem: Users want private, fast local transcription, dictation and TTS without third-party APIs or subscriptions, with better models than Whisper.
local & open models.who: Privacy-minded users and developers wanting local voice
local & open models.current_solutions: whisper-server, parakeet-mlx, Voxtral Realtime, GLM-ASR, Ghost Pepper, FluidAudio, VibeVoice-ASR, Cohere Transcribe, Qwen3 TTS, audio.cpp, WebGPU pipelines.
local & open models.opportunity: A turnkey local voice stack and polished apps combining STT, VAD, TTS and LLM with server mode.

local & open models.title: Open decision models as local classifiers
local & open models.problem: Users want an open, local, low-latency classifier or decision model and single-token logprob classification.
local & open models.who: Developers needing local classification
local & open models.current_solutions: CLM, Clef, Decision 3.0, GGUF logprob classification.
local & open models.opportunity: Ship a packaged local classifier with GGUF builds and benchmarks.

local & open models.title: LM Studio crashes, regressions and platform bugs
local & open models.problem: LM Studio has recurring bugs: failing to quit, runtime updates breaking vision models, Vulkan blue screens, hanging downloads and GPU detection failures. Conversations also leak earlier chat fragments and overflow small contexts.
local & open models.who: LM Studio users on desktop GPUs
local & open models.current_solutions: Disabling the headless service, switching Vulkan to CUDA, force quitting, using llama.cpp directly, manually raising context length.
local & open models.opportunity: Build a more stable local runtime or GUI with diagnostics, per-GPU control and automatic context/KV cache management.

local & open models.title: Open-weight license ambiguity for commercial use
local & open models.problem: Custom licenses with revenue gates, attribution and usage policies make commercial deployment unclear.
local & open models.who: Companies deploying open-weight models commercially
local & open models.opportunity: Build a license analyzer that summarizes obligations and thresholds for each open model.

local & open models.title: Missing day-one llama.cpp support for new models
local & open models.problem: New architectures lag in llama.cpp, forcing forks, patches or waiting for community GGUFs. Tooling and changelogs lag too.
local & open models.who: local model users and open-weight publishers
local & open models.current_solutions: Merged PRs, forks, community GGUF conversion, Transformers GGUF loading
local & open models.opportunity: Build an automated pipeline that tracks upstream support and publishes compatible GGUFs.

local & open models.title: Debate over ultra-low-bit quantization usability
local & open models.problem: People dispute whether 1-bit, 2-bit and ternary quants keep capability, with reports of degraded tool calling, looping and failure to terminate. Qwen at Q4 loops while FP8 stays stable.
local & open models.who: Users of aggressively quantized local models
local & open models.current_solutions: Unsloth 1-bit GGUFs, Bonsai, Q3 and Q4 mixes, FP8 or BF16 KV cache, forced subagents.
local & open models.opportunity: Agentic-task evals and diagnostics that detect looping and show where low-bit quants break.

local & open models.title: Ollama frustrations: outdated llama.cpp, cloud push, format failures
local & open models.problem: Ollama ships an outdated llama.cpp, pushes cloud services, and fails on many community GGUF quants and templates.
local & open models.who: Local model users relying on Ollama
local & open models.current_solutions: Switching to llama.cpp, LM Studio, vllm-metal or llama-swap, and running Unsloth GGUF directly in llama.cpp.
local & open models.opportunity: A transparent, up-to-date local model server that handles quant and template compatibility.

local & open models.title: Specialized small open models for enterprise tasks
local & open models.problem: Enterprises need cheap, fine-tuned, owned small models for repetitive internal tasks, but open models fall short out of distribution.
local & open models.who: Enterprises with repetitive internal workloads
local & open models.current_solutions: LoRA adapters, distillation into sub-8B students, Liquid AI, Granite, medgemma.
local & open models.opportunity: Services for distilling and fine-tuning small specialized models as tools for frontier agents.

local & open models.title: Complete open local AI stack beyond weights
local & open models.problem: Open models lack the integrated harness, search, document ingestion and agents that hosted products bundle, so they underperform.
local & open models.who: Users wanting hosted-like experiences locally
local & open models.current_solutions: OpenJarvis, Hermes Agent, Pi agent, Unsloth Studio.
local & open models.opportunity: An end-to-end open source local stack with chat, ingestion, agents and search tools.

local & open models.title: Local agents suffer prompt reprocessing and cache failures
local & open models.problem: Local agent stacks resend and reprocess full prompts each turn, flood context with tool output, and break caching, making agents slow and unreliable.
local & open models.who: Users of local agent stacks
local & open models.current_solutions: Unsloth guide for Claude Code settings, cache-stable prompt layouts.
local & open models.opportunity: A local agent proxy that does incremental prompts, prompt caching and tool-output trimming.

local & open models.title: Open model adoption and ecosystem tracking dashboards
local & open models.problem: Teams lack current data on which open models are really adopted and cost-competitive, and on US vs China share.
local & open models.who: Teams choosing open models
local & open models.current_solutions: Interconnects hub and dashboards, relative adoption metrics.
local & open models.opportunity: Maintain a live open-model tracker with usage and adoption metrics.

local & open models.title: Browser-based local inference with WebGPU
local & open models.problem: Running models in browsers is hampered by missing CUDA-only support and repeated multi-GB downloads.
local & open models.who: Web developers deploying local models in the browser
local & open models.current_solutions: WebGPU with Transformers.js, ONNX Runtime Web, Bonsai Image in browser.
local & open models.opportunity: Tooling for caching and converting models to run well in browsers.

local & open models.title: Fully open model releases and transparency
local & open models.problem: Few open-weight models release data, recipes and checkpoints, making reproducible research hard.
local & open models.who: Researchers and open-model advocates
local & open models.current_solutions: Olmo 3, Nemotron 3 Nano, openness scoring.
local & open models.opportunity: A transparency scoring tracker for models.

local & open models.title: Local diffusion text models lack runtime support

local & open models.who: Enthusiasts trying diffusion LLMs locally
local & open models.current_solutions: Unsloth GGUFs for DiffusionGemma.
local & open models.opportunity: Add runtime support and tooling for diffusion LLMs.

local & open models.title: Remote access to local model servers
local & open models.problem: Users want to reach their home LLM servers securely from other devices.
local & open models.who: Home-lab local LLM users
local & open models.current_solutions: Tailscale or SSH tunneling, LM Link, a remote LM Studio plugin.
local & open models.opportunity: Simple secure remote access to personal inference servers.

local & open models.title: Safety refusals and verbosity reduce open model usefulness
local & open models.problem: Some open models waste tokens on safety validation and refuse tasks.
local & open models.who: Open model users

local & open models.title: Local embedding models for search
local & open models.problem: Users need efficient local embedding models for search and retrieval.
local & open models.who: Developers building local search
local & open models.current_solutions: Qwen embedding, EmbeddingGemma, Jina.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Managed RL and fine-tuning services for non-experts
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Teams want plug-and-play RL and fine-tuning across many models, including large open models, without managing GPUs or needing deep ML expertise. Fine-tuning as a service hasn't taken off because each model needs bespoke decisions.

model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Offer a managed autoscaled fine-tuning/RL service with synthetic data, eval building, verifiable rewards and simple configuration.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Fine-tuning large models on limited VRAM
model training & fine-tuning.problem: People on consumer or free GPUs hit OOM errors when fine-tuning or running GRPO on large or long-context models, and cannot easily estimate memory needs.
model training & fine-tuning.who: hobbyists and small teams with consumer or free GPUs
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: QLoRA, activation offloading, fp8 Adam, DeepSpeed ZeRO-3, packing, context parallelism, Unsloth kernels and notebooks, Kaggle QLoRA, AMD support, Axolotl, GGUF LoRA in Transformers
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a memory/compute estimator and packaged low-VRAM pipelines that recommend a feasible config for a given model, GPU and method.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Continual learning and forgetting after deployment
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Models forget, repeat mistakes and cannot learn from deployment feedback without retraining; weight edits cause side effects and fail multi-hop reasoning.

model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Create a system that learns from feedback and production traces and updates models safely with side-effect validation.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Distilling frontier models into small specialists
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Companies want cheaper, faster specialist models retaining most frontier capability on narrow tasks, and a fast path to build them.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Shopify/Liquid, Harvey on Kimi, Cursor Composer, Databricks KARL, Legora, Ramp PorTAL, fine-tuning Qwen 8B, trace collection
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Provide an end-to-end engine that turns a workload's frontier traces into a deployed small specialist with evals and routing.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Buggy RL environments and reward hacking
model training & fine-tuning.problem: RL and RLVR environments are often broken, impossible or hackable, so models learn to cheat and generalize misaligned behavior; fixes are ad hoc.
model training & fine-tuning.who: teams building and training on RL environments
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: LLM judge inspecting tool calls, Lean verification, rubric-based RL, reverting checkpoints, safeagents guards, model-graded rewards
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build tooling that audits RL environments for bugs and exploit paths and detects reward hacking during runs.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Agentic RL training frameworks are slow and buggy
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Frontier-scale, multi-turn and long-horizon RL needs custom infrastructure and suffers tokenization mismatches, train-inference mismatch, synchronous bottlenecks, memory limits and hard debugging.
model training & fine-tuning.who: teams doing RL on long-horizon agents and reasoning models
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Atropos, Miles, slime, VeRL, SkyRL, Token-In Token-Out, decoupled rollouts, TRL AsyncGRPO, Axolotl async GRPO, ZoRRo, delta weight refits
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build efficient, debuggable RL infrastructure with correct tokenization, decoupled async rollouts and observability for long trajectories.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Open recipes and cheap from-scratch pretraining
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Frontier post-training and pretraining recipes are complicated, undocumented and withheld, so small teams struggle to reproduce them affordably.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Open recipes, Tulu 3, Megatron, NeMo, $200 1.1B model, Instella-MoE, fully open 375B release
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build reproducible open training stacks with data, configs and checkpoints.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Robot and embodied training data scarcity
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Robots and embodied agents need large data and simulated worlds, but simulation misses real physics and teleoperation is costly. Standard post-training recipes are lacking.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Egocentric-10K, gameplay clips, teleoperation, RL from trials, world models, action chunking, LLM-written rewards, fleet learning
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Provide tooling for synthetic 3D worlds, few-shot robot adaptation, reward generation and policy evaluation in world models.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Dataset building and synthetic data generation is tedious
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Creating, cleaning, balancing and generating datasets is costly, and synthetic data is hard to make useful. Chatlogs and expert knowledge are underused.
model training & fine-tuning.who: teams building fine-tuning and training datasets
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Local LLM async loops, dataset distillation, expert interviews, agentic synthetic generation, data mix proxies, labeling vendors
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Provide tooling that turns logs, documents and expert input into clean, balanced, curated synthetic datasets.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Fine-tuning side effects and training-run mistakes
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Narrow fine-tuning shifts persona and causes misalignment or sycophancy, and frontier runs accidentally include CoT or bad data with no reliable catch before damage.
model training & fine-tuning.who: teams fine-tuning and running training pipelines
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Inoculation prompting, introspection adapters, character training, pausing runs, rolling back checkpoints
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build training-run monitoring and post-tuning audits that detect contamination, leakage and behavior shifts.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Scarcity of hard verifiable RL environments
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Scaling RL needs thousands of realistic, executable, verifiable environments that humans cannot build fast enough.
model training & fine-tuning.who: labs and startups doing RL post-training
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Buying environments from startups, synthetic environment generation, open releases, Hugging Face Hub, compiling environments from Agent Skills
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Platform or marketplace for generating, verifying and versioning RL environments.

model training & fine-tuning.title: GRPO and RL fine-tuning instability
model training & fine-tuning.problem: GRPO and related runs suffer exploding gradients, reward hacking, zero loss, collapse and length-driven gibberish. Users lack stable configs.

model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Ship a GRPO training monitor with presets and auto-diagnosis of instability and reward hacking.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Unsloth install, dependency and export breakages
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Fine-tuners hit dependency conflicts, TRL version incompatibilities, saving/export quirks and sparse docs with Unsloth. Simple runs turn into debugging sessions, and multi-GPU and vocab handling have gaps.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Downgrading trl to 0.24, patching Unsloth code, GitHub issues, Unsloth guides
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a validated pinned environment and preflight checker that catches version, driver, export and token-resize problems before training.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Distillation degrades students and inherits teacher flaws
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Distilling from stronger teachers can make students worse, transfer undesirable traits, and lose signal with only API outputs; weak models trained on expert trajectories can degrade.

model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build tooling to evaluate, filter and audit distilled data for inherited traits and quality.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Agents automating training research
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Researchers want agents to run training experiments, ablations and post-training loops autonomously and compound results.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Karpathy autoresearch, ml-intern, PostTrainBench agents, Poolside Model Factory
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build agentic tools that automate ablations and post-training iteration.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Domain-specific and small-model fine-tunes
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Specialized domains and low-resource languages lack tuned models and pipelines, and small models underperform out of the box with unclear method choices.
model training & fine-tuning.who: teams building domain-specific or small models
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Continued pretraining, CoT datasets, SFT for classification
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Offer domain fine-tuning services with curated data.

model training & fine-tuning.title: MoE training and post-training tooling is immature
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Open-source MoE training is poorly optimized, unstable and hard to tune or load, with train/inference expert mismatch, so some labs use dense models.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Writing-quality and personal style training

model training & fine-tuning.who: writers and individuals wanting personalized models
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Fine-tuning on own writing
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a style fine-tuning service or writing-focused model trained for voice.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Distillation legitimacy and ToS abuse debate

model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Access restrictions, account bans

model training & fine-tuning.title: Removing refusals, dangerous knowledge and unwanted behavior
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Safety refusals block benign tasks so users abliterate models, while developers also want to remove dangerous capabilities but filtering can be undone and tuning has side effects.
model training & fine-tuning.who: users and developers customizing model restrictions
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Heretic abliteration, pretraining data filtering, gradient routing

model training & fine-tuning.title: Quantization and GGUF export tools fail on big models

model training & fine-tuning.title: Scientific and biology model training

model training & fine-tuning.title: Era-limited and public-domain language models

model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Manual template debugging, chatML formatting
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Create a fine-tune debugger that validates templates, tokenization and data formatting and flags likely causes of bad output.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Small pretraining runs fail or destabilize
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Small-scale pretraining and MoE or architecture experiments suffer stalled loss, instability and gradient explosions.
model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: nanochat recipe, pretraining tiny models from scratch

model training & fine-tuning.title: Training data auditing and poisoning
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Training data quality issues such as preference-data pathologies, poisoning and ineffective filtering need better tooling.

model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Predictive data debugging
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a dataset auditing tool for preference/DPO and SFT data.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Open models differ in finetunability

model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build a benchmark/tracker of finetunability across open base and post-trained models.

model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Offer services to train agent models inside customers' harnesses.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Custom post-trained models get obsoleted by new base models

model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Keep raw training data to cheaply re-run post-training
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build pipelines that re-run post-training automatically on new base models.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Licensed and ethically sourced training data
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Fully licensed or open training data is scarce, and datasets carry restrictive licenses.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Training models on human behavior data

model training & fine-tuning.current_solutions: Post-training on preregistered RCT data
model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Build datasets and tuned models for predicting human behavior.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Efficient reasoning via length-controlled RL
model training & fine-tuning.problem: Reasoning models waste tokens; controlling effort and concision without hurting accuracy is needed.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Deep RL scaling and distillation

model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Distill deep RL teachers into shallow students.

model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Offer a hosted tool or registry for lossless delta compression and adapter transfer.

model training & fine-tuning.title: Non-reproducible SFT results across GPU setups

model training & fine-tuning.opportunity: Offer a reproducibility harness that records and controls hardware, seed and data-order variables.
