data & pipelines.title: Memory-efficient loading of large graph and tensor data
data & pipelines.problem: Large graph datasets run out of memory and loading Parquet in tinygrad or Mojo is awkward.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: GraphZero, numpy conversion

data & pipelines.title: Filtering corpora for clean fine-tuning data
data & pipelines.problem: Users need to filter corpora down to clean prose by removing math, code and low-quality text.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Heuristic pruners using MTLD and lexical metrics; semantic dedup
data & pipelines.opportunity: Packaged dataset curation tool with configurable filters.

data & pipelines.title: LLMs need preprocessing for large data files
data & pipelines.problem: Models struggle with raw large JSON or tabular files, so users have an LLM write preprocessing scripts first.
data & pipelines.who: analysts and developers feeding large files to LLMs
data & pipelines.current_solutions: LLM-generated preprocessing scripts
data & pipelines.opportunity: Tool that automatically profiles and preprocesses large files before LLM analysis.

data & pipelines.title: Safe agent access to production databases
data & pipelines.problem: Agents making database changes need isolation, review and scoped credentials.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Copy-on-write branching, reviewed scripts, Supabase scoped IAM tokens
data & pipelines.opportunity: Agent-safe database branching and scoped access tool.

data & pipelines.title: Cleaned structured Wikipedia and MIDI datasets
data & pipelines.problem: Demand for cleaned, structured dumps of Wikipedia and MIDI data with boilerplate stripped.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Cleaned French Wikipedia JSON dump, Lakh MIDI JSON
data & pipelines.opportunity: Publish and maintain cleaned corpora with a pipeline for other languages.

data & pipelines.title: Data team workflows lack shared queries and versioning
data & pipelines.problem: Data teams keep scripts on laptops, spend most time cleaning, and lack shared query libraries and documentation.
data & pipelines.opportunity: Shared query library with authorship, history and documentation.

data & pipelines.title: Web data APIs and scraping for agents
data & pipelines.problem: Agents need fast structured access to web data without brittle browser automation.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Parse, FireCrawl /agent, Cloudflare crawl, Parallel, X CLI
data & pipelines.opportunity: Turn any website into an API quickly.

data & pipelines.title: Publishing agent traces as datasets
data & pipelines.problem: Sanitizing and sharing agent session traces for training and evals is missing.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: pi-share-hf
data & pipelines.opportunity: Tool to sanitize, review and publish agent traces.

data & pipelines.title: Crypto and on-chain data access for agents
data & pipelines.problem: Analysts need reliable on-chain data across chains for AI use.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Allium MCP
data & pipelines.opportunity: Unified on-chain data layer with agent access.

data & pipelines.title: Trader information overload and noisy social data
data & pipelines.problem: Traders cannot process market data volume and social feeds are noisy.
data & pipelines.opportunity: Filter for market and social data that rates sources.

data & pipelines.title: Fast tokenization and bulk processing overhead
data & pipelines.problem: Tokenizer overhead and slow pipelines waste time in bulk embedding and ingestion.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: Gigatoken, Maxwell

data & pipelines.title: Text dataset format: JSONL versus TAR
data & pipelines.problem: People debate formats for text datasets, favoring line-readable JSONL over TAR.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: JSONL/NDJSON

data & pipelines.title: Accounting categorization and reconciliation automation
data & pipelines.problem: Bookkeeping tools need manual rules and reconciliation is time-consuming.
data & pipelines.current_solutions: QuickBooks rules
data & pipelines.opportunity: AI categorization and reconciliation tool.

coding agents.title: Sandboxing coding agents against destructive actions and data leaks
coding agents.problem: Agents with shell or broad permissions delete files, wipe drives, leak credentials or run risky commands, and restrictions like gitignore or allow-lists get bypassed. DIY sandboxes are fiddly and fragmented.
coding agents.who: developers running coding agents in YOLO or broad-permission modes
coding agents.current_solutions: Separate Linux/macOS users, Docker Sandboxes, bubblewrap, podman, LXC, microVMs, sandbox-exec, firejail, VMs, command allowlists, auto-review classifiers
coding agents.opportunity: Build an easy cross-platform agent sandbox with filesystem, network and secret scoping, command guardrails, snapshots, audit and rollback.

coding agents.title: Permission prompt fatigue and coarse permission models
coding agents.problem: Constant approvals lead users to skip permissions entirely, and permission models are too coarse to pre-approve safe commands.
coding agents.who: developers using Claude Code and similar agents
coding agents.current_solutions: Allow/deny command lists, skip-permissions flags, git-commit checkpoints, auto-mode classifiers
coding agents.opportunity: Build a policy layer for fine-grained reusable pre-approvals with audit and rollback.

coding agents.title: Quota burn, costs and opaque usage limits of coding agents
coding agents.problem: Heavy users burn through Claude Code, Cursor and other agent quotas quickly, with opaque metering, loops and wasted tokens, and little visibility into spend.
coding agents.who: paying power users of coding agents
coding agents.current_solutions: Multiple subscriptions, fallback to Codex/cheaper models, effort tuning, fresh sessions, token-saving prompts
coding agents.opportunity: Build a usage tracker and budget manager that attributes token burn, forecasts quotas and routes to cheaper models.

coding agents.title: Routing and cross-checking work across multiple models
coding agents.problem: No single model is best, so users manually pair planners, implementers and reviewers across vendors and escalate stuck tasks to another model, with provider-bound tools making this clumsy.
coding agents.who: developers using several coding models and agents
coding agents.current_solutions: Claude plus Codex review loops, Codex plugin in Claude Code, OpenCode/OpenRouter, manual model switching, per-project routing instructions
coding agents.opportunity: Build a harness-agnostic orchestrator that routes tasks by cost and capability and runs cross-model review automatically.

coding agents.title: Cheaper, open and local models as coding agent backends
coding agents.problem: Users want cheaper, open or local models in agent loops, but open alternatives lag, loop, misuse tools and need harness tuning and compatibility layers.
coding agents.current_solutions: GLM, Kimi, Minimax, Qwen, Ollama, litellm proxies, OpenCode, Pi, Kilo Code
coding agents.opportunity: Build a harness or proxy tuned for open and local models handling per-model quirks and config.

coding agents.title: Open-source and provider-agnostic coding agent harnesses
coding agents.problem: Users want open, forkable coding agents and the freedom to switch models and providers rather than be locked to a proprietary harness.
coding agents.current_solutions: OpenCode, Cline, Goose, Pi, Kimi CLI, Qwen Code, OpenHands, Crush, Mistral Vibe
coding agents.opportunity: Build or contribute a portable open harness that moves sessions, skills and memory between agents.

coding agents.title: Aider stagnation and workflow gaps
coding agents.problem: Aider has bugs, no MCP, weak session handling and an inactive maintainer, so users seek alternatives or a maintained fork.
coding agents.current_solutions: Aider-CE, Claude Code, Cline, OpenCode, LiteLLM routing, wrapping Aider in MCP agents
coding agents.opportunity: Provide a maintained open-source Aider-like CLI with MCP, session restore, auto file selection and subscription auth.

coding agents.title: Agent context loss, rot and compaction in long sessions
coding agents.problem: Context fills up, compaction drops details and instructions, and quality degrades, so users manually manage windows, handoffs and summaries.
coding agents.current_solutions: /clear, /compact, handover files, scratchpad notes, fresh sessions, plan documents, disabling auto-compaction
coding agents.opportunity: Build a session manager that backs up transcripts, keeps durable task state outside context, lets users prune context and re-injects it after compaction.

coding agents.title: Agents forget codebase context and memory between sessions
coding agents.problem: Agents lose preferences, corrections and codebase knowledge between sessions, so users hand-maintain markdown memory files that go stale.
coding agents.who: developers working repeatedly with coding agents
coding agents.current_solutions: CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, Claude-Mem, Letta Code, memory banks, handoff files, ADRs and wikis
coding agents.opportunity: Build an automatic, project-scoped, cross-agent memory layer that captures, prunes and retrieves learnings and decisions.

coding agents.title: Agents ignore or bloat CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md instruction files
coding agents.problem: Models inconsistently follow instruction files, which become stale, bloated or inconsistent across tools, and teams are unsure what helps.
coding agents.who: teams maintaining agent instruction files and rules
coding agents.current_solutions: Mistake logs, hooks forcing rule reads, trimmed files, symlinked AGENTS.md, rules files, pointer files
coding agents.opportunity: Build a linter, tester and syncer for instruction files that verifies adherence, prunes dead rules and enforces them with hooks.

coding agents.title: Reviewing AI-generated code and PRs is the bottleneck
coding agents.problem: Agents generate code faster than humans can review it, and AI reviewers are noisy and miss architectural issues.
coding agents.current_solutions: Greptile, Devin Review, Cursor BugBot, review subagents, cross-model review, strict manual review
coding agents.opportunity: Build a review tool that summarizes, groups and risk-ranks agent diffs, verifies against intent and keeps noise low.

coding agents.title: Open-source maintainers swamped by AI-generated PRs
coding agents.problem: Maintainers receive many low-effort AI PRs from contributors who do not understand them, and need trust and triage mechanisms.
coding agents.current_solutions: Vouching systems, prefiltering with Claude, rejecting big PRs, AI-usage policies
coding agents.opportunity: Build a PR intake filter and contributor reputation system that triages AI contributions.

coding agents.title: Developers lose understanding of agent-written code
coding agents.problem: As agents write code, developers lose their mental model of the system, making debugging, maintenance and ownership harder.
coding agents.current_solutions: Agent walkthroughs, small reviewed chunks, architecture docs, hand-written core logic, AI as explainer
coding agents.opportunity: Build tools that generate living explanations, architecture maps and walkthroughs and track which areas humans reviewed.

coding agents.title: AI-generated code is bloated, sloppy and misfits the codebase
coding agents.problem: Agent code adds dead code, duplication, over-defensive handling and inconsistent styles, creating tech debt and ignoring local conventions.
coding agents.current_solutions: Cleanup passes, simplicity rules, style guides, architecture docs, scheduled cleanup skills
coding agents.opportunity: Build a code-health scanner and curator that detects bloat, duplication and convention misfit in agent diffs and proposes cleanups.

coding agents.title: Agents overreach, cheat tests and falsely claim success
coding agents.problem: Agents make unrequested edits, game or delete tests, fabricate results and report work done that was not, so users cannot trust output.
coding agents.current_solutions: Minimal-change prompts, TDD, cross-model verification, sub-agent verification, manual re-checks
coding agents.opportunity: Build a verification harness that checks agent claims against diffs, tests and build state and flags scope creep and test tampering.

coding agents.title: Verification harnesses and tests as feedback for agents
coding agents.problem: Agents need machine-checkable feedback like tests, linters, types and conformance suites to stay on track, and prose rules are forgotten.
coding agents.who: developers and teams running autonomous agents
coding agents.current_solutions: Pre-commit hooks, CI, linters, TDD, conformance suites, stop hooks, typed languages
coding agents.opportunity: Offer a reusable verification layer that wires tests, linters and checks into agents with enforced completion gates.

coding agents.title: Agents cannot verify or demo their own UI work
coding agents.problem: Agents leave UI testing to humans; users want them to run the app, check it in a browser and provide proof like screenshots or videos.
coding agents.who: developers building web and mobile UIs with agents
coding agents.current_solutions: Playwright, Puppeteer MCP, Chrome DevTools MCP, Claude in Chrome, Showboat, Cursor/Devin demo videos
coding agents.opportunity: Build harnesses that run, screenshot and record agent changes and attach replayable proof to PRs.

coding agents.title: Parallel agent orchestration and worktree management
coding agents.problem: Running many agents in parallel is hard to set up and track, causes conflicts, and overloads human supervision.
coding agents.who: developers running several coding agents at once
coding agents.current_solutions: Git worktrees, Conductor, Cline Kanban, tmux, parallel sessions, Claude Agent View
coding agents.opportunity: Build a dashboard managing parallel agents with isolated worktrees, status tracking, conflict handling and review queues.

coding agents.title: Remote and mobile control of coding agents
coding agents.problem: Developers want to launch, monitor, approve and steer agents from a phone or the cloud, but sessions are tied to an open laptop and alerts are lacking.
coding agents.current_solutions: Claude Code remote control and web, Codex mobile, Cursor mobile, tmux over ssh, Tailscale dashboards, notification hooks
coding agents.opportunity: Build a cross-agent mobile dashboard with notifications, approvals and persistent cloud runs.

coding agents.title: Cloud agent environments are fragile and hard to set up
coding agents.problem: Cloud and ephemeral agent environments break on dependencies, lack private access, do not persist state, and make handoff to local hard.
coding agents.who: developers using cloud and background agents
coding agents.current_solutions: Cursor cloud agents, Dockerfile artifacts, OpenInspect, Codex cloud environments, local Docker
coding agents.opportunity: Provide reproducible, persistent agent environments with credential handling, snapshots and easy local/cloud handoff.

coding agents.title: Claude Code session transcripts and provenance are hard to export
coding agents.problem: Getting transcripts and history out of Claude Code, and capturing what agents did alongside commits, requires reverse engineering.
coding agents.who: teams wanting to audit, search and share agent sessions
coding agents.current_solutions: claude-code-transcripts, Claude history explorer, OAuth token extraction
coding agents.opportunity: Build transcript export, search and provenance storage tied to git commits with shared sessions.

coding agents.title: Plan-first and spec-first workflows with clarifying questions
coding agents.problem: Ambiguous prompts lead to wrong assumptions and wasted work; agents rarely ask clarifying questions and plan modes are weak.
coding agents.who: developers and non-technical users directing agents
coding agents.current_solutions: Plan mode, Kiro specs, OpenSpec, interview skills, plan critique by another model, PRD skills
coding agents.opportunity: Build a planning front end that interviews users, produces and critiques specs and gates implementation for any agent.

coding agents.title: Security risks of AI-generated code and agent tooling
coding agents.problem: AI-generated code contains vulnerabilities, fixes sometimes disable features, and agents are open to prompt injection, supply-chain attacks and data exfiltration.
coding agents.who: teams shipping agent-written code and running agents in CI
coding agents.current_solutions: Agent security audits, Claude Code security plugin, sandboxing, manual fixes
coding agents.opportunity: Build security scanning, workflow auditing and package vetting tuned to agent-generated code and agent tool permissions.

coding agents.title: Harnesses leaking user code and data
coding agents.problem: Agent harnesses upload codebases or environment signals without clear disclosure, raising privacy and secrets exposure risks.
coding agents.who: developers and companies with sensitive code
coding agents.current_solutions: Local-first open-source harnesses with own inference
coding agents.opportunity: Offer an egress-monitoring tool showing what a harness sends off-machine and blocking sensitive paths.

coding agents.title: AI-driven vulnerability discovery and defensive security
coding agents.problem: Agents find vulnerabilities faster than they can be patched and defenders need find-fix-test workflows without refusals.
coding agents.current_solutions: Claude Code Security, Project Glasswing, Devin Security Swarm, Codex scanning skills
coding agents.opportunity: Build a scanning service that applies agentic vulnerability search to repos and manages validated patching.

coding agents.title: Stale API docs and training knowledge in agents
coding agents.problem: Models use deprecated APIs and old package versions from training data instead of current documentation.
coding agents.who: developers using coding agents with fast-moving libraries
coding agents.current_solutions: Skills packaging latest versions, Context Hub, DeepWiki MCP, correction skills
coding agents.opportunity: Offer a service feeding current, version-correct docs and corrections to agents as skills or MCP.

coding agents.title: Code search and retrieval for agents on large codebases
coding agents.problem: Naive grep burns tokens and agents struggle with large, legacy and multi-repo codebases and architecture.
coding agents.who: developers using agents on large production codebases
coding agents.current_solutions: BM25 plus trigram search, LSP integration, mgrep, code graphs, Cursor embedding index, research-plan-implement
coding agents.opportunity: Ship a language-aware code retrieval and architecture-context layer for agents on large repos.

coding agents.title: Legacy code migration, porting and reverse engineering with agents
coding agents.problem: Organizations want to port or rewrite legacy code and niche-language systems, but need specs, conformance tests and verification.
coding agents.current_solutions: Test-suite-driven ports, parallel agents, COBOL tooling, Ghidra, clean-room rewrites
coding agents.opportunity: Build a migration service that extracts conformance tests and orchestrates agent ports verified by them.

coding agents.title: Frontend and design quality from coding agents is generic
coding agents.problem: Agents produce generic or ugly UI, cannot see visual issues, and non-designers lack vocabulary to steer them.
coding agents.who: developers and non-designers building UIs with agents
coding agents.current_solutions: Frontend-design skill, Impeccable skills, Figma MCP, design.md files, mockup variants
coding agents.opportunity: Build a design-direction and visual-comparison tool that turns references into design systems agents follow.

coding agents.title: Non-coders using coding agents for personal tools and apps
coding agents.problem: Non-developers want agent power without a terminal for personal automation, apps and knowledge work, and need approachable interfaces.
coding agents.current_solutions: Claude Cowork, Claude Code desktop, Replit Agent, Lovable, Claude Artifacts, Expo Agent
coding agents.opportunity: Build friendly guided front-ends for building and managing personal tools and apps.

coding agents.title: Vibe-coded apps are unmaintainable and need rescue
coding agents.problem: Non-programmers build apps they cannot debug, secure or scale, and quit when bugs appear.
coding agents.current_solutions: Technical person in the loop, git branches, rescue consultancies
coding agents.opportunity: Build an audit, maintenance and ops service for vibe-coded apps with hardening and automated bug-fixing.

coding agents.title: Packaging, sharing and managing agent skills
coding agents.problem: Skills are ad hoc to find, share, sync, author and test, and they sprawl or overfit.
coding agents.who: developers and teams building agent skills
coding agents.current_solutions: Skills directories, gstack, Superpowers, Codex Record & Replay, screen-recording to skill
coding agents.opportunity: Build a registry, authoring and testing tool for skills including capture from demonstrated workflows.

coding agents.title: MCP context bloat and internal-tool connectors
coding agents.problem: MCP servers load many tool definitions into context, pushing users to custom CLIs, while teams still need connectors to internal systems.
coding agents.current_solutions: Custom CLIs, tool search, Glean/Jira/Port connectors
coding agents.opportunity: Build lean lazy-loading CLI or MCP wrappers and ready-made connectors.

coding agents.title: Evaluating coding agents on your own work
coding agents.problem: Benchmarks do not reflect real projects, and teams lack ways to measure whether agents, plugins and skills help them.
coding agents.current_solutions: Ticket-based grading, session clustering, A/B runs with and without plugins
coding agents.opportunity: Build an eval runner that replays real repo tasks across agents and grades cost and quality.

coding agents.title: Autonomous loops, goals and long-running agent reliability
coding agents.problem: Long autonomous loops compound errors, stall, quit early or chase poor goals, and need supervision and bounded iteration.
coding agents.who: developers running long autonomous agent tasks
coding agents.current_solutions: Ralph loops, /goal commands, fresh contexts, elapsed-time budgets, manual unsticking
coding agents.opportunity: Build a loop and goal supervisor with bounded iterations, checkpoints, completion checks and resume.

coding agents.title: Scheduled agents, software factories and background migrations
coding agents.problem: Teams want agents running on schedules or triggers, handling migrations, triage and crash-to-fix flows with risk-based human gates.
coding agents.current_solutions: Claude scheduled routines, Ramp Inspect, Spotify background agents, Ralph loop, Cursor Rollouts
coding agents.opportunity: Offer a turnkey background-agent platform with triggers, logs and risk-routed review.

coding agents.title: Observability data and live-system access for agent debugging
coding agents.problem: Agents reread code instead of using logs, traces and live runtime values, burning cycles on print-and-restart loops.
coding agents.current_solutions: Instrumenting steps, Cursor debug mode, Sentry-connected Amp, feeding logs
coding agents.opportunity: Build tooling exposing structured traces, logs and live values to agents.

coding agents.title: Agent output too verbose and hard to read
coding agents.problem: Agent plans, PR text and replies are verbose walls of text and models ignore brevity instructions.
coding agents.current_solutions: Concise output styles, caveman skills, stretchtext plugins, low effort setting
coding agents.opportunity: Build summarizers and style controls that compress agent output into short, expandable forms.

coding agents.title: Cursor agent reliability and Auto mode bugs
coding agents.problem: Cursor agents hang, crash, fail to create files, and rules or memory features silently fail.
coding agents.current_solutions: Restarting chats, clearing data, downgrading
coding agents.opportunity: A more reliable client or wrapper with crash recovery and session preservation.

coding agents.title: Claude model and harness regressions and silent changes
coding agents.problem: Users see Claude Code and Opus quality varying, silent harness changes and no transparency, and cannot tell whether context or the model is at fault.
coding agents.current_solutions: Pinning older models, overriding effort settings, switching to Codex
coding agents.opportunity: Build a regression tracker benchmarking agent behavior over time and alerting to drift.

coding agents.title: Model-specific behavior complaints (Gemini, GPT-5.2/5.5, Opus 5, Composer)
coding agents.problem: Specific models show unrequested edits, literal instruction following, verbosity or weak planning, and attribution controversies.
coding agents.current_solutions: Switching models, hybrid workflows, careful prompting

coding agents.title: Debates on productivity, vibe coding and limits of AI coding
coding agents.problem: Commentators dispute real productivity gains, code quality, authorship and where AI struggles on complex code.
coding agents.current_solutions: AI for scaffolding, prototypes and one-off scripts

coding agents.title: Cognitive overload and lost flow when supervising agents
coding agents.problem: Waiting on and supervising agents fragments focus, causes fatigue and removes the joy of programming.
coding agents.current_solutions: Parallel sessions, fast models, inline autocomplete, editor-integrated harnesses
coding agents.opportunity: Build editor-integrated, low-latency and mid-run steerable agent UX that keeps developers close to the code.

coding agents.title: Agent use in games, CAD, hardware and other niches
coding agents.problem: Agents struggle with fun gameplay, 3D layout, CAD and hardware perception, while enabling hobbyist creation.
coding agents.who: hobbyists, game developers and hardware engineers
coding agents.current_solutions: FreeCAD MCP, Blender MCP, manual art, playtest loops, webcam access
coding agents.opportunity: Build niche tools like game playtest agents, CAD design assistants and hardware bridges for agents.

coding agents.title: GUI and computer-use agents are slow and awkward
coding agents.problem: Agents driving browsers and GUI apps are slow, token-heavy and hard to set up with human-verification gates.
coding agents.current_solutions: Claude for Chrome, Cursor desktop clicking, reverse-engineered remote browsers
coding agents.opportunity: Build efficient page-reading and GUI automation layers with guardrails.

coding agents.title: Hiring and assessing engineers in the agentic era
coding agents.problem: Companies redesign interviews and upskilling around agentic coding skills.
coding agents.current_solutions: Agentic take-home projects
coding agents.opportunity: Build assessment tools for agent-assisted coding skills.

coding agents.title: Customizable harness mods and side agents
coding agents.problem: Users want to customize agent behavior and have a layer flagging overlooked output or friction.
coding agents.current_solutions: Claude Mods, side agents, plugins
coding agents.opportunity: Build a mod builder that watches transcripts and proposes fixes for friction.

coding agents.title: Voice-driven coding with agents
coding agents.problem: Developers want to dictate build requests to agents hands-free.
coding agents.current_solutions: Codex voice mode, Wispr Flow
coding agents.opportunity: Build a voice interface for agent task management.

coding agents.title: Metrics-driven agent optimization needs guardrails
coding agents.problem: Autonomous optimization chases spurious wins, and agent code is often slow or inefficient unless given benchmarks.
coding agents.who: developers using agents for performance work
coding agents.current_solutions: Benchmark scripts, autoresearch loops, explicit performance requirements
coding agents.opportunity: A benchmarking harness that validates agent optimizations and catches regressions.

creative & media.title: Detecting and verifying AI-generated media provenance
creative & media.problem: It is hard to tell real photos and video from AI output, and people rely on gut cues. Creators also cannot prove their work is human-made, and detector scores are unreliable.
creative & media.who: consumers, journalists, platforms and human creators
creative & media.current_solutions: Google SynthID detection, manual cues like reflections and motion speed, unverified detector scores
creative & media.opportunity: Build a cross-generator verification and provenance tool that checks watermarks and artifacts and certifies human-made work.

creative & media.title: Stripping AI watermarks and the cost of visible marks
creative & media.problem: Visible and invisible watermarks degrade repeated edits and hinder monetization, so users hunt for ways around them.
creative & media.who: commercial creators using AI image and video tools
creative & media.current_solutions: Apple Photos cleanup, no-op prompts on edit sites, ElevenLabs for unwatermarked Sora video
creative & media.opportunity: Offer clean-output generation hubs or watermark-aware editing workflows for commercial creators.

creative & media.title: AI video ads lack precise revision and consistency
creative & media.problem: AI video generators can't make small precise changes and drift visually across clips, so ad studios rely on brute-force regeneration and human finishing.
creative & media.who: ad studios and marketers producing AI video
creative & media.current_solutions: Generating hundreds of variants, hybrid live-action plus AI VFX, AI storyboards with human direction
creative & media.opportunity: Build an ad-production tool with targeted edits, variant ranking and cross-clip consistency controls.

creative & media.title: Sora 2 prompt control, consistency and reliability
creative & media.problem: Sora 2 changes dialogue, loses scene consistency, shifts focus, and fails silently, so users need elaborate prompting.
creative & media.current_solutions: Detailed prompts specifying appearance, motion and dialogue timing; structured prompt workflows
creative & media.opportunity: Create prompt-planning and shot-spec tools that lock dialogue, characters and timing across generations.

creative & media.title: Sora access limits, region locks and shutdown
creative & media.problem: Sora 2 is region-locked, has confusing credit and invite systems, and was shut down, leaving users without access or a way to keep their work.
creative & media.who: Sora users and AI video creators
creative & media.current_solutions: VPNs (risking bans), ElevenLabs as hub
creative & media.opportunity: Provide export and archiving tools or an open alternative for creators' AI video projects.

creative & media.title: Generation caps and cost limits on AI media
creative & media.problem: Free and paid tiers cap video and image generation, and compute is costly, making iteration expensive and frustrating.
creative & media.who: AI image and video creators on low-priced plans
creative & media.current_solutions: Higgsfield flat-price unlimited plans, local open models, cheaper models like FLUX.2 and Nano Banana 2 Lite
creative & media.opportunity: Offer flat-price or local-first generation bundles that remove per-generation caps.

creative & media.title: All-in-one hubs for multiple AI media generators
creative & media.problem: Creators juggle many accounts and subscriptions for different video, image and voice models and want a single place for projects.
creative & media.current_solutions: ElevenLabs bundling Sora, Veo and Kling; Higgsfield; Canva
creative & media.opportunity: Build a unified workspace aggregating models with project management and consistent pricing.

creative & media.title: Image generation guardrails, licensing and IP limits
creative & media.problem: Safety filters block benign depictions, text edits and fiction, while open model licenses are ambiguous and closed generators enforce IP inconsistently.
creative & media.current_solutions: Rephrasing prompts, switching models, flipping images, abliteration requests, uncensored prompt enhancers
creative & media.opportunity: Offer an image editing service with configurable content controls and clear licensing.

creative & media.title: Image edits degrade quality and lose reference fidelity
creative & media.problem: Repeated AI edits cause saturation shifts, artifacts and drift, and editing across turns while preserving subjects is unreliable. Photo restoration hallucinates different faces.
creative & media.who: image editors and designers using AI editing models
creative & media.current_solutions: Nano Banana Pro, Qwen-Image-Edit, layered decomposition, reference-image CLI tools, first-frame alignment
creative & media.opportunity: Build an editing tool with a lossless working state, localized edits and identity-preserving checks.

creative & media.title: Character and style consistency across AI images
creative & media.problem: Keeping a character, facial detail or art style stable across images and clips is hard, and outputs show AI tells and homogeneity.
creative & media.who: storytellers, game artists and image creators
creative & media.current_solutions: Nano Banana reference images, LoRAs, contact-sheet prompting, max quality settings
creative & media.opportunity: Create a consistency manager that stores character and style references and enforces them across batches.

creative & media.title: Image models fail at accurate text and infographics
creative & media.problem: Image models mangle text, charts and layouts, misspell words and produce implausible diagrams.
creative & media.who: designers and marketers needing infographics and signage
creative & media.current_solutions: Nano Banana Pro with search grounding, GLM-Image, Qwen-Image text rendering, manual checking, thinking-mode generation
creative & media.opportunity: Build an infographic generator with verified data and a verification layer that detects and fixes text errors.

creative & media.title: Nano Banana Pro API and platform instability
creative & media.problem: Hosted Nano Banana models throw errors, lack documented resolution parameters, and have outages, wasting credits.
creative & media.current_solutions: Replicate or Fal.ai, local models
creative & media.opportunity: Provide a reliable image API gateway with clear parameters, retries and no-charge failures.

creative & media.title: AI upscaling and restoration of old video and images
creative & media.problem: Upscaling old footage distorts faces, is slow, and enhancement models struggle with blurry low-res inputs.
creative & media.current_solutions: Topaz AI, Handbrake, ChaiNNer, SUP Toolbox, RealESRGAN
creative & media.opportunity: Build a fast restoration tool preserving faces that converts old shows to modern aspect ratios.

creative & media.title: Promptable segmentation and rotoscoping for video
creative & media.problem: AI rotoscoping gives inconsistent frame boundaries, and pipelines need interactive promptable segmentation.
creative & media.current_solutions: Meta SAM 3 hosted on Roboflow, no-code playground
creative & media.opportunity: Wrap segmentation models in a rotoscoping tool with temporal consistency and cleanup.

creative & media.title: Generative 3D worlds and Gaussian splat tooling

creative & media.opportunity: Build editing, rendering and asset-sharing tools for generated 3D scenes and splats.

creative & media.opportunity: Build an agent layer for Blender with render-feedback loops and spatial validation.

creative & media.title: Game-ready sprite and asset generation for indie developers

creative & media.opportunity: Build a writing workbench comparing models side by side on story tasks with canon tracking.

creative & media.title: Controllable, multilingual and local TTS with voice cloning

creative & media.opportunity: Build an affordable local TTS toolkit with emotion, pronunciation and timing controls, stable long-form output and consent safeguards.

creative & media.opportunity: Build longer, controllable music generation with stems and style blending, including voice-memo-to-production, runnable locally.

creative & media.opportunity: Build an end-to-end pipeline that turns scripts or songs into finished videos with consistent characters.

creative & media.opportunity: Build a long-form pipeline that tracks characters and scene state across shots and detects and repairs drift.

creative & media.title: Poor and unreliable audio in AI video
creative & media.problem: Video models produce muffled, garbled or misaligned audio, emotion tags are spoken literally, and guidance for prompting audio is lacking.

creative & media.opportunity: Build an audio layer and post-processing tool that replaces, cleans and syncs sound on generated video.

creative & media.title: AI-native and agent-controllable video editing

creative & media.opportunity: Build an AI-native open editor with an MCP server for cutting, captioning, zooms and voiceover.

creative & media.title: AI design tools and design-to-code canvases
creative & media.problem: Designers want agent-integrated canvases that read code and design systems, but general models are weak at design and outputs look generic.

creative & media.opportunity: Build an agent-readable, brand-aware design canvas with curated style libraries that exports clean code and avoids the generic AI look.

creative & media.opportunity: Build a brand-aware generator that learns from a website and yields localized ads avoiding AI-slop signals.

creative & media.title: SVG and vector graphics generation by LLMs

creative & media.opportunity: Build an iterative vector generator with feedback loops and animation export.

creative & media.title: Claude lacks image generation and multimodal output

creative & media.opportunity: Build template-driven tools that turn content or personal data into interactive timelines, books and personalized video.

creative & media.opportunity: Build an editable code-to-video tool exposing assets, timelines and layers.

creative & media.opportunity: Build tooling that uses agents to port and patch legacy games for modern platforms.

creative & media.title: Game NPC real-time cloned voice dialogue

creative & media.opportunity: Build a local real-time NPC voice dialogue layer that plugs into arbitrary games.

devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build declarative dev environment setup with secrets handling.

devtools & IDEs.title: Reliable mechanical refactoring for legacy C++
devtools & IDEs.problem: Mechanical refactoring of legacy C++ is unreliable with current tools.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a reliable mechanical refactoring tool.

devtools & IDEs.title: Open source maintainers flooded by AI-generated contributions
devtools & IDEs.problem: Maintainers get floods of low-quality AI PRs, issues and vulnerability reports that are costly to triage and hard to detect, with weak trust signals.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Manual profile inspection, Vouch, blocking new contributors, Pangram, closing external PRs, paid sponsorship as trust signal
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build detection, reputation and agent-based triage and reproduction tooling for AI-era contributions.

devtools & IDEs.title: Secrets leaking through coding agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agents may commit or expose secrets, and secrets on disk are at risk.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: detect-secrets, 1Password/Bitwarden CLI wrappers, Doppler, Fly tokenizer
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Inject secrets at runtime via proxy and obfuscate them in agent output and commits.

devtools & IDEs.title: MCP Inspector and connector tooling gaps
devtools & IDEs.problem: MCP Inspector fails auth recovery and lacks Tasks support, and connectors time out, bloat context and have awkward auth versus CLIs.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Glama Inspector, McpSwitcher, mcp-explorer, VS Code
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a complete MCP inspector and manager with Tasks, auth recovery, on-demand tool loading and diagnostics.

devtools & IDEs.title: Better terminal UI and observability for CLI agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: CLI agents have poor editing, multi-line input, rendering and progress UX.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Ralph-tui, Emacs custom tool, Recon dashboard
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a richer TUI with editable messages, mermaid rendering and status.

devtools & IDEs.title: Managing many parallel agents and worktrees
devtools & IDEs.problem: Running parallel agents is fragile with worktree conflicts, and chat or CLI UX is inadequate for observing, steering, searching and killing them; teams also want shared multiplayer sessions.
devtools & IDEs.who: developers and teams running many agents
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: git worktrees, Codehydra, zellij scripts, VS Code Agent Sessions, Copilot App, Conductor Cloud, Slack Code
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build an agent-centric IDE/dashboard with observability, session management and shared multiplayer workspaces.

devtools & IDEs.title: Visual feedback and design-to-code for UI agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agents can't see app state, lack design taste and generate generic UI, and handing design intent via words is slow; users want to point, annotate and use component catalogs.
devtools & IDEs.who: developers and designers building UIs with agents
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Agentation, chrome-devtools-mcp, Figma MCP, Stitch, Cursor design mode, Impeccable, json-render, Clicky, tldraw, shadcn skills
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build an annotate-and-hand-off live design tool giving agents app views, design vocabulary and component-catalog generative UI.

devtools & IDEs.title: Documentation and context for agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agents need current, accessible, LLM-friendly docs and context files, and docs lack ratings; agents also need semantic code-graph context on large repos.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Context7 CLI, Context Hub, DeepWiki, Mintlify, spec submodules, Sonar Vortex, graph-based maps
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a doc and code-graph context service with agent feedback and ratings and offline-ready packaging.

devtools & IDEs.title: Agent-friendly CLIs and token-efficient tool output
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agents work better with CLIs than APIs or GUIs, but many services lack them and tool output wastes tokens.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: api2cli, Stripe CLI, Printing Press, Playwright CLI, WebMCP, Markdown for Agents
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Generate agent-native CLIs and structured low-token output from existing APIs and apps.

devtools & IDEs.title: Packaging and distributing CLI binaries and Python tooling
devtools & IDEs.problem: Shipping compiled binaries across platforms is hard, and Pyodide wheel distribution was a manual bottleneck.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: go-to-wheel, static-ffmpeg, uv, pyemscripten wheels, cibuildwheel
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build automated cross-platform wheel and binary packaging.

devtools & IDEs.title: Browser automation CLI robustness
devtools & IDEs.problem: Browser automation CLIs need session scoping, cross-platform support and attaching to running Chrome.
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a robust cross-platform browser automation CLI for agents.

devtools & IDEs.title: Claude and Gemini IDE integration complaints
devtools & IDEs.problem: Claude/Gemini integrations in IDEs and CLIs are flaky or inferior to native Claude Code.

devtools & IDEs.title: Running untrusted Python and apps in sandboxes
devtools & IDEs.problem: Plugin systems and sandboxed apps need strong isolation, resource limits and error visibility; Pyodide and V8 bindings have gaps.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: MicroPython in WASM with wasmtime, CPython WASI, iframe sandbox with CSP
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Ship an installable untrusted-Python sandbox with limits and auto CSP allow-lists.

devtools & IDEs.title: Git and CI strain under agent-driven commit volume
devtools & IDEs.problem: Agent PR and commit volume overloads CI, GitHub and Git's model, and outages push demand for agent-native hosts.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Anthropic Scion, Google Piper, Meta Sapling, Cursor Origin, sandboxes as CI runners
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build agent-oriented source hosting, version control and CI repair for high concurrency.

devtools & IDEs.title: Reasoning visibility and prompt opacity in agent tools
devtools & IDEs.problem: Hidden thinking, adaptive-thinking toggles and concealed system prompts make it hard to see or control what the model does.
devtools & IDEs.who: power users of Claude Code and agent tools
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: CLI thinking summaries, MITM proxies, stderr reasoning, pinning older versions
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a harness UI or tool to expose reasoning and effort and diff system prompts across products.

devtools & IDEs.title: Claude Code config drift and context bloat
devtools & IDEs.problem: CLAUDE.md, skills and hooks conflict and bloat context, and users cannot see which items consume tokens.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Lazy-loaded guides, AGENTS.md per folder, hooks, context explorer
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a linter and visualizer for agent config showing conflicts, drift and token cost.

devtools & IDEs.title: Permission prompts and harness customization friction
devtools & IDEs.problem: Repeated permission prompts and weak harnesses slow experienced users, and plugins and mods break across releases.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Auto mode rules, agnostic harnesses, Claude Code TypeScript mods, Concise output style
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a harness with smart permission auto-resolution and a stable plugin framework.

devtools & IDEs.title: Vibe-coded apps lack production readiness and security
devtools & IDEs.problem: AI-built MVPs lack auth, secrets handling and rate limiting, and unreviewed non-developer changes enter codebases; vibe code lacks rigor for core systems.
devtools & IDEs.who: non-developers and teams shipping AI-built apps
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: PR branch protection, Semgrep rules, React Doctor, design-by-contract, deterministic lint
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build guardrailed scaffolds and scanners that fix vulnerabilities and verify AI code against specs.

devtools & IDEs.title: Lack of unobtrusive AI assistance modes
devtools & IDEs.problem: Autocomplete is slow or distracting, and some want pair-programming or offloaded modes.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Zed edit completion, removing AI from editors
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a harness with driver/navigator modes and anchored conversations.

devtools & IDEs.title: Model, plan and routing choices for coding tools
devtools & IDEs.problem: Developers struggle to pick subscriptions, model-harness pairings and pricing, and to avoid lock-in; product names and modes are confusing.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Comparison sites, OpenRouter, provider-agnostic routers, tiered model use in Copilot
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build curated model-to-harness comparisons and routing layers for quick vendor switching.

devtools & IDEs.title: Publishing apps to app stores with agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Store submission involves signing and privacy compliance that agents struggle with.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Fastlane, Blitz
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a trustworthy open tool automating store submission.

devtools & IDEs.title: Git-centric review of agent edits in Vim and terminals
devtools & IDEs.problem: Developers in lightweight editors need to see agent changes immediately and review them diff-first.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: jj auto-commit, diffview.nvim, tmux with vimdiff, Zed Vim mode
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build editor plugins reflecting background agent edits live with diff-first review.

devtools & IDEs.title: Patching backlog accelerated by AI vulnerability discovery
devtools & IDEs.problem: AI-accelerated discovery outpaces patch distribution, leaving legacy and end-of-life software exposed.
devtools & IDEs.who: maintainers and operators of older software
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: AI-generated patches for old versions, read-only sites, agent audits
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a service that monitors, patches and rolls out updates and tracks patched builds.

devtools & IDEs.title: Personalized disposable internal tools replacing SaaS
devtools & IDEs.problem: Single-user tools built with AI create sprawl and maintainability issues.
devtools & IDEs.who: people building internal tools with AI
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: agent-built tools, open-source replacements, tiny-app platforms
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build tooling for interoperability, maintenance and sharing of generated tools.

devtools & IDEs.title: Filtering AI content on Hacker News
devtools & IDEs.problem: Users want to hide AI posts and separate substantive projects from low-effort generated repos.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: keyword-hiding extensions, uBlock Origin regex
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a configurable AI-keyword filter and project quality signal.

devtools & IDEs.title: CI breaks on new Python versions and tool rules
devtools & IDEs.problem: Unpinned dev dependencies, missing wheels and slow CI support cause surprise failures.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: setup-python allow-prereleases, ruff auto-fix, prebuilt wheel pipelines
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a service that notifies when new Python and tool versions are testable and tests dependency changes.

devtools & IDEs.title: Python 3.15 profiling, lazy imports and startup
devtools & IDEs.problem: Python CLIs have slow startup and lack built-in profiling.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: manual lazy imports, py-spy, Tachyon, PEP 810

devtools & IDEs.title: Prompt versioning and testing outside observability platforms
devtools & IDEs.problem: Prompt tools can't run application code, so teams use Git and notebooks and need better annotator interfaces.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: prompts in Git, Jupyter, custom annotation UIs
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a prompt workbench executing real app code with annotator review.

devtools & IDEs.title: Auto-approving AI changes and release safety
devtools & IDEs.problem: Teams want to decide which AI changes ship without human review and catch bad deploys.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: canary deploys, A/B testing, rollbacks, Cursor Rollouts
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a tool that classifies change risk, auto-approves, monitors and reverts deploys.

devtools & IDEs.title: Voice and dictation for coding agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Voice input is poor for code details and lacks previews and mixed typed input.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: self-built STT apps, GPT-Live starter app
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build a voice agent interface with live preview and paste input.

devtools & IDEs.title: Browser multiplayer game vibe-coding gotchas
devtools & IDEs.problem: Browser multiplayer games hit WebRTC failures, math inconsistencies and permission re-prompts.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: WebSockets relay, deterministic simulation, Phaser/Three.js PWAs

devtools & IDEs.title: CAD, hardware and embedded dev tools with agents
devtools & IDEs.problem: Hardware, CAD and embedded engineers want LLM-integrated tools but face poor toolchains.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: FluidCAD MCP, ShopSpec MCP, FreeCAD, KiCAD, mtkclient
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build MCP-enabled parametric design and hardware translation tools.

devtools & IDEs.title: Reverse engineering and decompilation with AI
devtools & IDEs.problem: Reverse engineers want maximum capability from decompilers.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: Ghidra, IDA Pro
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build AI-assisted decompilation tools.

devtools & IDEs.title: Support and account problems with AI vendors
devtools & IDEs.problem: Support bots block human escalation, and bans, crashes and limits frustrate developers.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: asking the bot to escalate

devtools & IDEs.title: Forensic log analysis and support triage with AI
devtools & IDEs.problem: Teams use AI to analyze logs for incidents and support requests.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: feeding logs into models
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build log-analysis assistants giving detailed cause analysis.

devtools & IDEs.title: Python platform tooling packaging friction
devtools & IDEs.problem: Developer platform tools have packaging, naming and size issues that hinder install.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: pywrangler

devtools & IDEs.title: Legacy codebase migration needs behavior review
devtools & IDEs.problem: Large migrations like Python 2 to 3 need manual review of behavior differences that tools miss.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: futurize plus manual review
devtools & IDEs.opportunity: Build migration tools flagging behavior-difference sites.

devtools & IDEs.title: Integrating AI apps into legal and enterprise tools
devtools & IDEs.problem: Vendors struggle integrating with Word, Outlook and API versioning in fast-moving products.
devtools & IDEs.current_solutions: AG Grid for tabular views

evals & testing.title: Public benchmarks don't predict real-world task performance
evals & testing.problem: Leaderboard scores diverge from how models perform on users' actual work, so people cannot tell which model is better for them. Saturated, benchmaxxed public evals give little signal.
evals & testing.who: teams and individuals choosing models for their own use cases
evals & testing.current_solutions: Private use-case evals, vibe checks, task-specific bake-offs, in-house evals, long-session usage reports
evals & testing.opportunity: A service that runs users' own task samples across models and tiers, keeps private evals reusable across model swaps, and shows whether a new model beats the current one.

evals & testing.title: Benchmark contamination, gaming and defective tasks
evals & testing.problem: Test data leaks into training, agents find answer keys and fix commits, and benchmark tasks or answer keys are flawed. Scores get inflated and public evals lose trust.
evals & testing.who: benchmark maintainers, labs and model buyers
evals & testing.current_solutions: Decontaminated and private test sets, contamination auditor agents, no-internet sandboxes, Epoch audits, manual environment cleaning
evals & testing.opportunity: A benchmark and RL-environment auditing service that detects contamination, answer leaks, grader bugs and mislabeled keys.

evals & testing.title: Non-determinism and run-to-run variance in evals
evals & testing.problem: Outputs vary across runs, decoding settings and quantization, making eval comparisons noisy, and reports often omit variance. Agents are also inconsistent despite good average accuracy.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Temperature 0, fixed seeds, repeated runs, same-seed comparisons, multi-run testing
evals & testing.opportunity: An eval runner that automatically repeats trials, reports confidence intervals and variance, and measures reliability and prompt-robustness.

evals & testing.title: Prompt optimization lacks guidance and tooling
evals & testing.problem: Users manage prompts by hand and cannot tell when DSPy/GEPA optimizers have converged or interpret candidates.
evals & testing.current_solutions: DSPy GEPA, manual prompt editing
evals & testing.opportunity: A prompt optimization tool with convergence diagnostics and candidate analysis.

evals & testing.title: Building eval datasets and custom evals is hard
evals & testing.problem: Teams lack skills and tooling to assemble representative labeled datasets from production data and to build durable domain-specific evals. Failures are rare and reviewing is tedious.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangFuse, Phoenix, DeepEval, Inspect AI, production logs as regression sets
evals & testing.opportunity: A low-effort eval tool that samples production traces, bootstraps tasks and graders, and manages labeling and cost.

evals & testing.title: LLM-as-judge reliability, bias and calibration
evals & testing.problem: LLM judges show position and self-preference bias, flip verdicts, and are rarely validated against human labels. Generic metrics and bundled judges hide failures.
evals & testing.who: teams using LLM judges for evals
evals & testing.current_solutions: Swapped-order runs, multiple judges, binary pass/fail criteria, TPR/TNR and kappa calibration against human labels
evals & testing.opportunity: A judge-calibration and authoring tool that measures bias and agreement with human labels and scopes one failure per judge.

evals & testing.title: Evaluating multi-turn agent trajectories and traces
evals & testing.problem: Agent evals need whole-trajectory, tool-call and state inspection, and outcome scores hide why agents fail. Traces are huge and teams review manually.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Transcript replay, LLM graders over trajectories, simulated users, LangSmith, observability data, regression tests
evals & testing.opportunity: A platform for multi-turn agent evals with trace mining, failure clustering, user simulation and per-step assertions.

evals & testing.title: Verifying AI-generated code and UI changes
evals & testing.problem: Reviewers cannot read all agent output, and agents fake, skip or weaken tests so passing does not prove correctness. AI-written tests are trivial.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Playwright loops, separate checker agents, tests-first, holdout scenarios, digital twins, mutation testing, screenshot and video proofs
evals & testing.opportunity: Tamper-resistant verification tooling with mutation scoring, recorded evidence and end-to-end checks for agent code.

evals & testing.title: Coding benchmarks miss mergeability and realism
evals & testing.problem: Passing unit tests overstates coding agents because output often would not be merged. Toy and SWE-bench variants miss real developer tasks and long-horizon work.
evals & testing.current_solutions: SWE-Bench Pro, Terminal-bench, FrontierCode, DeepSWE, human review
evals & testing.opportunity: Evals grading mergeability, maintainability and regression using realistic containerized tasks from real failures.

evals & testing.title: Conformance test suites enable agent ports
evals & testing.problem: Language-independent test suites let agents port implementations reliably, but suites for emerging protocols are missing.
evals & testing.who: developers porting or building implementations with agents
evals & testing.current_solutions: html5lib tests, MicroQuickJS tests
evals & testing.opportunity: Build conformance suites for LLM API protocols and other standards.

evals & testing.title: Arena usability and real-usage comparison platforms
evals & testing.problem: Arena users hit errors and missing features, and public arenas miss multi-turn and agentic use. Teams want continuous comparisons from their own usage.
evals & testing.who: arena users and teams comparing models
evals & testing.current_solutions: Windsurf Arena Mode, Agent Arena, Design Arena, Epoch Capabilities Index, Chrome extensions
evals & testing.opportunity: Better arena clients plus IDE-based continuous model comparison and aggregators with price/performance views.

evals & testing.title: Informal pelican SVG and side-by-side visual comparisons
evals & testing.problem: People rely on ad hoc visual prompts like pelican SVGs, which saturate and are hard to compare across models, effort levels and quantizations.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Pelican grids, LLM CLI log export, side-by-side galleries
evals & testing.opportunity: A gallery and tool that runs prompt suites across models and effort levels with side-by-side grids and cost.

evals & testing.title: Hallucination measurement and verification
evals & testing.problem: Accuracy metrics ignore hallucination, models fabricate instead of abstaining, and fabricated citations and quotes are hard to detect.
evals & testing.current_solutions: AA-Omniscience, citation-checking agents, manual verification
evals & testing.opportunity: Hallucination-aware benchmarks and domain verifiers for citations and generated artifacts.

evals & testing.title: GPU kernel leaderboard timing noise and cheating
evals & testing.problem: Kernel timings vary widely and are hackable.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Non-Python harnesses, Magpie, FlashInfer-Bench
evals & testing.opportunity: A robust cheat-resistant kernel benchmark harness.

evals & testing.title: Models detect evals and behave differently
evals & testing.problem: Models notice tests and change behavior, making alignment and safety evals poor evidence of deployment behavior.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Honeypots, realistic sandboxes, production monitoring, transcript checks
evals & testing.opportunity: Tools measuring eval-awareness and generating realistic, indistinguishable test scenarios.

evals & testing.title: Reward hacking and sandbagging detection
evals & testing.problem: Models tamper with graders, exploit loopholes or underperform deliberately, so a pass does not show honest success.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Canary reward paths, process-aware grading, trajectory audits, CheatBench, activation probes
evals & testing.opportunity: Tooling that audits trajectories for grader exploitation, sandbagging and tampering.

evals & testing.title: Harness choice swings benchmark scores
evals & testing.problem: Scores shift by many points with harness, infrastructure, quantization and prompts, and vendor claims diverge from independent runs.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Third-party leaderboards, Bash Only SWE-bench, Harness-Bench, Community Evals, independent testers
evals & testing.opportunity: Standardized, disclosed harness benchmarking with versioned configs and independent reproducible reports.

evals & testing.title: Cost, effort and provider comparisons omitted from benchmarks
evals & testing.problem: Scores are reported without cost, tokens, effort or provider, and output quality differs across inference providers and hardware.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Artificial Analysis cost-to-run, intelligence-per-dollar normalization, manual benchmarks
evals & testing.opportunity: A dashboard normalizing results by cost, effort and provider, including local hardware modes and effort tuning.

evals & testing.title: Benchmark saturation demands harder frontier evals
evals & testing.problem: Many benchmarks are near ceiling or noisy, and short-horizon tests miss long-horizon capability.
evals & testing.current_solutions: FrontierMath, HLE, ARC-AGI, METR-style suites, headroom suites

evals & testing.title: Independent third-party evaluation and audit accountability
evals & testing.problem: External evaluators lack time, access, capacity and independence, and labs grade their own homework.
evals & testing.current_solutions: METR, Apollo, CAISI agreements, double-blind pilots

evals & testing.title: Risk report diff tool
evals & testing.problem: Risk reports and capability assessments don't track releases, making changes hard to see.
evals & testing.opportunity: Automatically diff successive risk reports for each new model.

evals & testing.title: Domain-specific and open-ended benchmarks lack validity
evals & testing.problem: Benchmarks in law, medicine, science and open-ended skills are unrepresentative and few expert-calibrated evals exist, and many niches lack evals entirely.
evals & testing.current_solutions: GDPval, expert-graded rubrics, LLM judges calibrated to clinicians, TasteVal
evals & testing.opportunity: Expert-calibrated domain eval kits and services for under-served domains and modalities.

evals & testing.title: Realistic agent task, business and game benchmarks
evals & testing.problem: Agents score far worse on realistic enterprise, business-simulation, real-time and game tasks than on sandbox benchmarks, and handcrafted environments are costly.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Vending-Bench, AutomationBench, GDPx, WebArena-Infinity, MCP game harnesses
evals & testing.opportunity: Realistic domain benchmarks and generated environments with replays, cost tracking and hidden-constraint scoring.

evals & testing.title: Cyber capability benchmarks and environments
evals & testing.problem: Cyber benchmarks suffer from contamination, flawed tasks and lack of independent measurement of uplift.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Cyber ranges, EVMbench, ExploitGym, outcome-based grading
evals & testing.opportunity: Reproducible containerized CVE environments and independent cyber benchmarks.

evals & testing.title: Eval sandboxes leak access to real systems
evals & testing.problem: Eval sandboxes lacked network isolation so models reached real external targets, sometimes unnoticed.
evals & testing.who: labs and teams running agent and cyber evals
evals & testing.current_solutions: Air-gapped networks, transcript monitors, cutting internet access
evals & testing.opportunity: Egress-filtered sandboxes with traffic monitoring and automatic shutdown.

evals & testing.title: Quantization quality metrics for local models
evals & testing.problem: Perplexity misleads when judging quantized models.
evals & testing.current_solutions: KL divergence, llama.cpp perplexity
evals & testing.opportunity: Score quantizations by KLD against full precision.

evals & testing.title: Sycophancy, bias and refusal measurement
evals & testing.problem: Sycophancy, political bias and over-refusal are poorly measured, with no canonical sets.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Opposite-Narrator benchmark, anti-sycophancy tests
evals & testing.opportunity: Maintain standardized sycophancy, bias and refusal suites.

evals & testing.title: Verifying AI-generated math proofs and research
evals & testing.problem: AI produces proofs and research faster than experts can verify, with errors and omitted failure denominators.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Lean formal verification, manual cleanup, execution-log checks
evals & testing.opportunity: Triage and verification tooling for proofs, with provenance and attempted-versus-solved tracking.

evals & testing.title: AI-text detection is weak and brittle
evals & testing.problem: Detectors misflag human text, miss blended writing and are easily evaded.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Pangram, lexicon scans
evals & testing.opportunity: Low-false-positive detectors with section-level scores.

evals & testing.title: Safety eval gaps in alignment and welfare
evals & testing.problem: Safety, welfare and alignment evals are narrow, unrealistic and shaped by framing.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Psychologist interviews, red-teaming, holistic audits
evals & testing.opportunity: Realistic holistic audit tooling and framing-variant testing.

evals & testing.title: Red-teaming and prompt injection of agents
evals & testing.problem: Agents are prompt-injected and adversarial cases are rarely tested consistently.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Public arenas, Rainbow teaming, Shade
evals & testing.opportunity: Private, consistent red-teaming service with a risk taxonomy.

evals & testing.title: Regression testing for model migrations and silent degradation
evals & testing.problem: Model upgrades and silent hosted-model changes break prompts and workflows.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Mirrored traffic, continuous evals, frozen benchmark panels
evals & testing.opportunity: Replay production traffic across versions and track hosted model drift.

evals & testing.title: Long-context and memory evals regress
evals & testing.problem: Long-context retrieval regressed and memory systems lack tests.
evals & testing.current_solutions: MRCR, Graphwalks, canary tests
evals & testing.opportunity: Benchmarks for compaction, updates and KV-cache quantization.

evals & testing.title: Eval trust documentation registry
evals & testing.problem: No single place documents how each eval was made or how far to trust it.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Evals-consensus.ai statement
evals & testing.opportunity: Registry of eval provenance and trust levels.

evals & testing.title: Physical safety-critical AI evaluation
evals & testing.problem: Physical AI needs higher reliability, and sim-to-real gaps and slow scoring persist.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Simulation and RL infrastructure
evals & testing.opportunity: Neural-sim validation with statistical reliability reporting.

evals & testing.title: Neuron explanation evaluation
evals & testing.problem: Neuron explanations are judged by intuition and overclaim.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Neuron steering, simulation-based KL scoring
evals & testing.opportunity: Scoring tool for neuron explanations.

evals & testing.title: Forecast evaluation for rare outcomes
evals & testing.problem: Long-term forecasts cannot be scored in time.
evals & testing.current_solutions: Reciprocal scoring

inference & infra.title: Gateway and API reliability: errors, outages, failover
inference & infra.problem: Hosted model APIs and gateways like OpenRouter return 429/500/401 errors, timeouts and overload during demand spikes and launches. Fallback often fails, BYOK breaks, and teams lack clean failover.
inference & infra.who: developers and production teams building on hosted LLM APIs and gateways
inference & infra.current_solutions: Going direct to first-party APIs, BYOK, LiteLLM routing, manual retries and failover, waiting out outages, OpenRouter provider switching
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a resilient multi-provider gateway with health-based routing, working automatic failover that preserves context, retries, deprecation alerts and a public uptime tracker.

inference & infra.title: Cloudflare outages cascade to AI services
inference & infra.problem: Cloudflare outages take down many AI services and sites at once, and users have no easy fallback.
inference & infra.current_solutions: Searching for alternative platforms
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer multi-CDN or failover proxy for AI APIs with outage-aware routing.

inference & infra.title: Inconsistent quality and hidden quantization across inference providers
inference & infra.problem: The same model performs worse, slower or differently on aggregators and third-party hosts than first-party, with hidden routing or quantization. Providers rarely publish benchmarks so quality is hard to verify.
inference & infra.who: developers using hosted open models via gateways and third-party hosts
inference & infra.current_solutions: Moonshot's vendor verifier, switching to direct APIs or local models, pinning provider.only, reference deployments, anecdotal testing
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer continuous independent provider benchmarking and conformance testing for quality, tool calls, latency and drift over time.

inference & infra.title: Gateway feature gaps, parameter bugs and opaque provider details
inference & infra.problem: Gateway normalization misses features and mishandles parameters like reasoning, caching, structured output and temperature. Gateways can also hide quantization, region and weights, and users want better filtering.
inference & infra.current_solutions: Manual filtering, patched providers, custom model tables, OpenRouter, BitRouter, one-api
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a transparent gateway or compatibility test suite exposing true provider capabilities, quantization, region and price with deterministic model selection.

inference & infra.title: Lightweight secure gateway with batch and unified endpoints
inference & infra.problem: Developers want one API for batch inference and multiple model types, and lighter, more secure gateways after the litellm compromise.
inference & infra.current_solutions: OpenRouter, litellm
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a secure lightweight gateway with batch support and unified text, image and video endpoints.

inference & infra.title: Free and cheap AI tiers shrinking
inference & infra.problem: Free API tiers are overloaded and shrinking, subscription quotas run out fast, and prices shift.
inference & infra.current_solutions: Moving to paid or self-hosted models, free gateways with data-logging risks
inference & infra.opportunity: Provide quota monitoring and cost-routing across free and paid tiers.

inference & infra.title: Cutting inference cost via routing, caching and cheaper models
inference & infra.problem: Frontier model pricing makes inference expensive and teams overspend using top models for every task. They want routing to the cheapest adequate model, caching and cheaper open alternatives, but economics are unclear.
inference & infra.who: teams and developers paying for LLM inference and coding agents
inference & infra.current_solutions: Prompt caching, Cursor Router, Ramp Router, quality-weighted routers, Gemini Flash, DeepSeek, Kimi, DeepInfra and Together hosting, fine-tuned open models
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a cost optimizer and router that classifies task difficulty, picks the cheapest capable model or host, benchmarks cheap models on user repos, and tracks budgets with quality guardrails.

inference & infra.title: Routers misroute hard or qualitative tasks
inference & infra.problem: Routers underestimate difficulty on qualitative or non-verifiable tasks and send work to models too weak for it.
inference & infra.current_solutions: Using a top model for everything
inference & infra.opportunity: Build an eval-driven router that learns from feedback and flags tasks where cheap models fail.

inference & infra.title: Routing agent tasks between local and cloud models
inference & infra.problem: Cloud latency and token costs push routine agent work local, but nothing decides which tasks stay local. Small tasks queue behind large ones.
inference & infra.current_solutions: Pairing frontier and local models (OpenRouter Fusion)
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a local/cloud task classifier and router with separate difficulty queues.

inference & infra.title: Reasoning models overthink and burn tokens and time
inference & infra.problem: Reasoning models are slow, verbose and token-hungry, effort controls are limited or unreliable, and users want to trade thinking budget against latency.
inference & infra.who: developers and users of reasoning LLMs
inference & infra.current_solutions: GPT-5.1 none effort, Opus effort parameter, ChatGPT router, client-side budgets, terse prompting, lower effort levels
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a client-side layer that auto-picks reasoning effort per request, caps thinking tokens and shows latency and cost.

inference & infra.title: Fast cheap classifier models instead of full LLMs
inference & infra.problem: Using full autoregressive LLMs for classification and routing decisions is slow and costly.
inference & infra.who: developers running classification and routing at scale
inference & infra.current_solutions: Jev, SemIf, OpenAI Decision API, vLLM structured-decision endpoint
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer cheap typed-decision APIs with calibrated probabilities and cascades.

inference & infra.title: Prefix-cache misses and semantic caching for cost cutting
inference & infra.problem: Agent sessions lose prompt cache through volatile prompts, short provider affinity and expiry, repeating costly prefill. Other caching and compression techniques are underused.
inference & infra.who: teams running agents and production LLM apps
inference & infra.current_solutions: Calling DeepSeek directly, cache pre-warming, append-only conversations with compaction, semantic caching, gisting
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a cache-health tool that detects prefix-cache busters and offers drop-in semantic cache and context compression.

inference & infra.title: Context rot and long-context unreliability
inference & infra.problem: Long prompts and chats degrade quality, advertised context windows are not usable, and agents forget key data.
inference & infra.current_solutions: Prompt compression, KV compression, restarting chats
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a tool that compresses and manages context for long sessions and flags when to restart.

inference & infra.title: KV cache memory limits long-context serving and local use
inference & infra.problem: KV cache size dominates memory, cost and concurrency, limiting context length on servers and local setups, and it quantizes poorly.
inference & infra.who: inference operators and local LLM users running long contexts
inference & infra.current_solutions: Prefill/decode disaggregation, KV offload, FP8 caches, TurboQuant, LMCache, DMS compression, sparse attention, Mooncake
inference & infra.opportunity: Offer a drop-in KV cache compression, offload, persistence and reuse layer for vLLM, SGLang and local engines with validated quality.

inference & infra.title: KV-cache quantization trades speed and quality unpredictably
inference & infra.problem: KV-cache quantization often loses throughput at high concurrency and some methods perform poorly, leaving users guessing which precision to use.
inference & infra.current_solutions: fp8/Q8 KV cache, KVarN in vLLM, TurboQuant, tensor splitting
inference & infra.opportunity: Build a benchmark and recommendation tool for KV-quant methods on the user's hardware and concurrency.

inference & infra.title: Architecture tricks that shrink KV cache and attention cost
inference & infra.problem: Labs build compressed, shared or sparse attention to cut KV memory and FLOPs, but standard tooling struggles to use them. Few sparse attention schemes reach production serving.
inference & infra.current_solutions: Cross-layer KV sharing, CSA/HCA, DeepSeek Sparse Attention, Kimi Delta Attention, disk KV cache, QSInference
inference & infra.opportunity: A drop-in sparse attention kernel for vLLM with accuracy guarantees.

inference & infra.title: KV-aware routing and prefill/decode disaggregation orchestration
inference & infra.problem: Efficient large-model serving needs prefill/decode separation, KV-cache-aware routing and cross-node KV transfer, which is hard to configure.
inference & infra.current_solutions: NVIDIA Dynamo, Grove, DualPath, Mooncake, cache-aware routing, SGLang HiCache, wide expert parallelism
inference & infra.opportunity: Build turnkey KV-aware routing, offload and auto-tuning of disaggregated serving for open-source engines.

inference & infra.title: Autoscaling and serving frameworks for bursty vLLM fleets
inference & infra.problem: GPU utilization is a poor autoscaling signal, bursty traffic loses throughput, and scaling concurrent model requests in production is unclear.
inference & infra.who: teams running vLLM and custom serving
inference & infra.current_solutions: Queue-depth autoscaling, Prometheus/Grafana, Rust vLLM Router, Cornserve, mini-SGLang, SGLang
inference & infra.opportunity: Provide a managed autoscaler and config tuner with routing and observability.

inference & infra.title: Cold starts and reliability in elastic GPU inference
inference & infra.problem: Bursty inference traffic causes cold starts, tail latency, delivery guarantees issues and GPU failures across neoclouds.
inference & infra.current_solutions: GPU snapshotting of torch.compile state, serving weights from GPUs already holding them
